jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Role summary

Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day.

We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. You'll own the products that turn that complexity into clarity, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, sales, and implementation to make sure what we build actually gets adopted.

Responsibilities

  • Product vision, grounded in real user needs

You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind.

  • Market scoping and opportunity-spotting

Scanning the logistics landscape, competitor moves, and customer signals to find where Bluerock should build next, not just what's already on the backlog.

  • Logistics know-how turned into product decisions 

Planning, transport execution, freight, last-mile — decisions that hold up against how operations actually run, not just how they're described to you.

  • The full lifecycle

From first idea to adoption. You don't hand off and disappear.

  • The connective tissue across the company 

When priorities compete or a customer escalation needs an answer fast, you're the one pulling the threads together.

The team you’ll join

You'll join an international product team with complementary skills and a shared passion for a good challenge, real, hands-on experience in logistics paired with genuine enthusiasm for technology. We don't settle for quick patches: we strive for quality, look for the sustainable solution over the easy one, and keep an eye on what next-level TMS should look like, not just what's in front of us today.

Life at Bluerock

We're a distributed team across the Netherlands, Italy, the US, and Canada that operates like one crew: local insight, global perspective. We're curious by default, self-driven without needing to be told twice, and genuinely joyful about solving hard logistics problems together. We're team-minded because the best answers rarely come from one person alone, and unapologetically reliable because our customers' supply chains don't get a “we'll fix it next sprint.” As one of us put it: at the end of the day, it's the people that make Bluerock.


  • 5+ years in product or project management within logistics, supply chain, or TMS — hands-on TMS experience is required.

  • Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Information Systems, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field  required.

  • A track record of delivering complex, high-stakes software implementations, on time and within budget.

  • Genuine ease operating cross-functionally. You connect engineering, sales, implementation, and customers without waiting for permission.

  • An appetite for ambiguity and change: a messy, fragmented workflow reads to you as an interesting problem.

  • Nice to have: API integration experience (WMS, ERP, visibility providers, customs), fluency with Agile tooling (Jira, Asana, Rocketlane), and PMP/PRINCE2 certification.

  • Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage customer relationships and stakeholder expectations effectively.

  • Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on delivering results in a fast-paced environment

Our hiring process

  • Hit the Apply button.

  • Join a 30 minute video call in the Introduction Interview

  • A couple of deeper interviews built to be a win-win, not an interrogation.

  • An offer, and the start of your journey with Bluerock TMS.


Bluerock TMS is an equal opportunities employer. We take pride in our diverse workforce and inclusive workplace. Within a small team of open-minded talents, we ensure an attractive learning environment that you are looking for!

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager Software
jobs.description:
About Optics11

Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

The Role

As Senior Product Manager Software you will build a deep understanding of the software we supply to our defense partners and clients.

You will have full product ownership including strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle and contribute to adjacent hardware product strategy and propositions to, jointly with our hardware product managers, build end-to-end solutions for our defense partners and clients. You build and structure our product discovery and delivery ways of working for the software domain.

You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with our hardware Product Managers, Data science, Software, R&D, Engineering Sales, Projects and Application Engineering teams.

No two weeks will look the same. You might speak with a defense partner about an operational challenge, turn feedback from a deployed product into a roadmap decision, test the feasibility of a new capability with System Engineering, or work with the Product Owner to translate priorities into executable increments. You will also collaborate with hardware Product Managers, Engineering, Sales and Customer Projects to ensure our software and hardware come together as one coherent solution.

You will own the software product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle, from discovery and business case through prioritization, delivery and performance.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will have established a clear, evidence-based software strategy, strengthened our discovery and delivery practices, and aligned teams around the capabilities that matter most. Your work will reduce uncertainty, improve investment decisions and help Optics11 deliver scalable, commercially strong software products that solve real problems for customers operating in demanding, high-stakes environments.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the software product strategy by defining and articulating the direction for assigned software products or value streams, identifying customer problems and market opportunities, and balance near-term opportunities with long-term company goals.

• Provide product design authority by ensuring software concepts, capabilities and development choices remain aligned with the Underwater Security product vision and strategy throughout the product lifecycle.

• Lead customer and market discovery by developing a deep understanding of customer needs, operational use cases and buying contexts, validating direction with customers and partners, and synthesizing feedback from deployed products.

• Own software roadmap development and prioritization by defining the capabilities required to address validated needs, balancing improvements, new functionality and technology evolution, and communicating priorities across relevant teams.

• Develop business cases and commercial input by defining success measures and commercial objectives, providing evidence for portfolio investment decisions, and supporting Product Marketing with product knowledge for pricing and launch readiness.

• Coordinate the product core team by working with System Engineering on requirements and feasibility, Product Ownership on executable increments, and Project Management on customer delivery, while aligning Sales, Business Development, Customer Projects and Engineering around progress, quality and outcomes.


• Master’s degree in engineering or design, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of experience in Software Product Management, with a proven track record of developing, deploying and maintaining software (platform) driven solutions in defense industry or another industrial high-tech / high compliance environment

• Strong understanding of software products, particularly in complex and regulated environments, e.g., industrial environments.

• In-depth knowledge of software product management and – strategy methodologies.

• Demonstratable experience in defining software product strategy and creating complete business cases.

• Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills at operational and management level

• Demonstrated critical thinking, adaptability to challenges, and a problem-solving mindset to creatively address user pain points.

• Proficiency in software industry standard tooling for software development and road mapping such as Jira / Jira Product Discovery / Jira Service Management, Confluence, BigPicture

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of conveying product level knowledge, decisions and roadmaps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Willingness to travel

• Drivers’ license B (or international equivalent)

Nice to Have

• Experience in defense industry or another industrial high-tech / high compliance environment

• Proficiency in JAMA Connect, Siemens Polarion, SAFe, Miro, Figma, Dovetail, Amplitude, PowerBI

• Proficiency in Dutch language is a plus

Security screening

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please check:

https://english.aivd.nl/topics/s/security-screening

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation.

We’re looking for innovative, driven Frontend Engineers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients: Growth & Expansion
jobs.description:
Your Role

As Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients (f/m/d) you own the complete growth loop for LIQID's digitally-led clients: from a newly created lead to the first investment, and from there to the next top-up, the second portfolio and the next product. Acquisition and expansion sit in one team with one mandate, so you build a single growth system instead of handing clients over at the funnel's end. LIQID is hybrid by design: for this segment the experience is digital-first, and you decide precisely where a human touch from our advisors accelerates conversion or growth – and where it doesn't.

What you'll do

  • End-to-End Segment Ownership: Own the digital client lifecycle from Lead → Signup → Checkout → First Investment → Activation → Expansion. You define the segment's North Star and KPI tree across conversion and expansion – lead-to-funded conversion, time to fund, time to first top-up, multi-product rate, share of wallet – and you are accountable for net new money from the segment, not for a single funnel stage.

  • Lead Conversion & Onboarding Experience: Design and optimize the journeys that turn leads into funded clients – lead nurturing, signup, onboarding and checkout – together with Product Design, Marketing and Sales. You shape the first-product strategy – which entry offer converts which persona – and make sure the brand promise and premium positioning carry through every step that builds trust and drives conversion.

  • Digital Up- & Cross-Sell: Turn first-time investors into multi-product clients: top-ups and savings plans, second portfolios, additional account types and access to new asset classes such as private markets. You find natural product sequences through path and cohort analysis, build the in-product moments and lifecycle campaigns that convert them, and prove impact with causal measurement rather than correlation stories.

  • Hybrid Where It Pays Off: Define when a human touch turns a hesitant prospect into a client or a single-product client into a long-term relationship – callback offers at checkout drop-off, advisor triggers at wealth thresholds, and a clean handover to our Private Wealth team as clients grow. Every human touchpoint is designed, triggered and measured, not left to chance.

  • Thought Leadership with Hands-on Mentality: Act as Product Manager and Product Owner for a cross-functional team of Engineering, Design and Product Ops, working closely with Marketing and Sales. Y ou build on shared onboarding and banking infrastructure owned by our platform teams, prioritize transparently by impact and effort – which also means saying no – and grow into the thought leader for digital wealth growth at LIQID.

What you bring

  • Background: 7+ years in Product Management or Growth for digital consumer products, with ownership of both conversion and monetization or expansion outcomes. FinTech, WealthTech, banking or subscription businesses are a strong plus.

  • Growth & Analytical Depth: Hands-on with funnel, cohort and LTV analysis. You define metrics before you build, establish baselines, can query data yourself, and know the difference between a significant result and a lucky one.

  • Technical & AI Fluency: Experience working with product analytics and CRM data. You are comfortable discussing architecture and API trade-offs with engineers and use AI tooling to prototype, analyze and ship faster.

  • Domain Curiosity & Client Empathy: Genuine interest in investing and capital markets, and an understanding that converting someone to invest a significant share of their wealth is a trust decision, not an impulse purchase.

  • Communication & Language: Fluent in German and English, able to align Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing and Sales around one growth agenda and to represent your roadmap credibly toward leadership. Drive & Motivation: Comfortable in fast-paced, high-ownership scale-up environments. Y ou want to own outcomes, not backlogs, and you are excited to build the growth engine of a digital-first wealth manager in an AI-native product organization.

What we offer

jobs.description:
About Weezevent

From iconic festivals such as Tomorrowland, Lollapalooza, BBK, and Boomtown to major sporting events like the Mexico GP or the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games, Weezevent supports events of all sizes and formats.

We are the French leader in online ticketing and the European leader in cashless payments. Through all the companies forming up the Weezevent Group, we offer a comprehensive suite of solutions including access control, CRM and staff management, used across a wide variety of events all over the world.

Founded in 2008, Weezevent received the European Fast 500 Innovation Award in 2014 and was included in the French Tech Next40 ranking in both 2024 and 2025. Today, the group employs over 180 people across France, the UK, Spain, Switzerland, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, Portugal and Canada, and deploys its solutions at around 1.000 major events each year.

Weezevent is looking for a Product Owner Finance (M/F based in Clichy).

Key Responsibilities:

Product Vision and Strategy: execute the overall vision and strategy for financial products (from ticketing sells to cashless payments, financial reporting, fiscal reporting, and accounting), ensuring alignment with business goals, country regulations and market demands.

Stakeholder Collaboration: act as the primary liaison between stakeholders (finance, compliance, sales, marketing) and the development team to gather requirements and prioritize features.
Detect and report payments incidents when impacting organizers appreciation.
Communicate the product vision and strategy effectively to stakeholders and team members.
Provide operational support to the Client success and Finance teams. Providing help for PSP configurations, responding to questions in Slack, triaging RUN requests and generating custom exports is key for the well functioning of the company.

Product Backlog Management: create, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, customer feedback, market trends, and regulatory requirements.
Write clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the development team.

Development and Delivery: work closely with the development team during sprints to ensure the product is being built according to specifications and timelines.
Review, QA and accept completed user stories to ensure they meet the acceptance criteria and deliver the expected value.

Market and User Research: analyze user data and metrics to inform product decisions and identify areas for improvement, particularly in payments technology.

Compliance and Risk Management: ensure that financial products comply with relevant country/tax/fiscal regulations, standards, and best practices, including GDPR, PCI-DSS, and other industry-specific requirements.
Identify and mitigate risks associated with financial products and solutions with a strong emphasis on compliance and regulatory adherence.

Performance Monitoring: monitor product performance and customer satisfaction, using data and analytics to track key performance indicators.
Implement changes and improvements based on performance metrics and user feedback.

Why it's a good move ?
You will be responsible for executing the vision, strategy, and roadmap for finance functionalities, infrastructure and operational capabilities related to all our products. This role involves collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, developers, designers, and business stakeholders, to ensure the successful delivery of financial products that meet market needs and regulatory requirements, with a strong focus on compliance.

Fundamentals to join us :

  • You have a Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field. MBA or relevant certification (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner) ;

  • You have +5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Consultant, or similar role, in a start-up, company or function where payment is core. Having a strong understanding of payments & financial concepts, markets, and instruments is mandatory.

  • You have a proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle.

  • You speak French fluently.

Just like you, we prefer to work with energetic, friendly and highly committed person. Take on new challenges in a creative sector, send us your CV and let's talk !

All of our positions are open to people with disabilities.

Compensation and benefits

We offer a salary of EUR 50,400–65,000 per year for this permanent contract based in Clichy with a hybrid working arrangement. Private health insurance is provided to cover your medical needs. Public transportation benefits support your daily commute. Paid sick leave ensures you have time to recover when needed. Home Office options offer flexibility in your weekly schedule. A casual dress code allows you to wear what makes you comfortable at work. Regular team events and social activities keep you connected with colleagues. A company laptop is provided from your first day.

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Problem You'll Solve

Prosus is building an AI-first future across a global portfolio that spans food delivery, e-commerce, fintech, and education. We invest over $100 million annually in AI, run 800+ models in production, and have deployed Toqan — our internal platform for building, testing, and deploying GenAI and agentic workflows — across the organisation. The scale of ambition is real; the challenge now is focus, coherence, and velocity.

As Group Product Manager for our AI Platform, you will own the multi-year product strategy for the platform that underpins every AI initiative across Prosus. This means defining and sequencing the roadmap for agent infrastructure, evaluation frameworks, model deployment pipelines, and the shared capabilities that internal teams — from applied science to application engineering — rely on to build and ship AI products. You will balance long-term platform investments against the immediate, high-impact needs of teams across the portfolio who are racing to deliver.

You will lead and mentor a team of product managers, instilling product discipline and building the PM talent pipeline that scales with the platform. You will partner closely with engineering and applied science leadership to shape the technical strategy — making the hard trade-offs between model performance, latency, cost, and reliability that determine what we can promise the business.

And you will be the connective tissue: the person who turns ambiguous, fast-moving business needs into clear requirements, who aligns stakeholders across functions and geographies, and who ensures that what we build is not just technically impressive but adopted, trusted, and measurably impactful.

Who You Are

You are a senior product leader who has lived through the messy reality of building platform products for internal teams — and loved it. You measure your success not by features shipped but by the velocity and quality of the teams who build on top of your platform.

You are deeply technical. You can engage substantively with engineering and applied science teams on model lifecycle, MLOps, evaluation frameworks, and infrastructure trade-offs — not as a bystander, but as a thought partner. You understand agentic architectures, LLM capabilities and limitations, and the operational realities of running AI in production at scale.

You are a people leader. You have managed and mentored product managers, and you take genuine pride in their growth. You set strategic direction, coordinate overlapping roadmaps into a coherent plan, and create the clarity that lets your team operate with autonomy and purpose.

You thrive in ambiguity. You have worked in fast-paced, high-scale environments where priorities shift and the path forward is not always clear. You do not wait for perfect information — you run rapid experiments, test hypotheses, and let data and user feedback guide the next step.

You are a communicator. You can simplify complex technical concepts for executive leadership one hour and dig into detailed requirements with an engineering team the next. You build trust across functions and geographies, and you are as comfortable pushing back as you are building consensus.

You are customer-obsessed — even when your customers are internal teams. You connect frequently with the people who use your platform, validate solutions through product discovery, and treat adoption as a first-class metric.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years in product management, with at least 3–5 years in formal people-management roles leading a team of product managers.

  • Demonstrated success owning platform-level or infrastructure products used by internal teams — ideally including AI/ML platform capabilities, MLOps tooling, or developer-facing services.

  • Hands-on experience with generative AI, LLMs, and the model lifecycle (training, fine-tuning, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring) in production environments.

  • Track record of defining and executing multi-year product strategies in fast-moving, high-scale environments.

Technical Depth

  • Ability to engage substantively with engineering and applied science teams on architectural decisions, infrastructure trade-offs, and AI system design.

  • Familiarity with agentic workflows, agent frameworks, and the operational patterns that make AI agents reliable at scale.

  • Strong data-driven decision-making: comfortable with analytics tooling, A/B testing, defining and tracking KPIs, and using metrics to measure adoption, accuracy, latency, and ROI.

  • Experience with modern product and engineering tooling (e.g., Databricks, Jira, Confluence, Figma) and agile methodologies.

Leadership & Influence

  • Proven ability to mentor and grow product managers, instilling PM best practices and building talent pipelines.

  • Stakeholder management across functions and geographies — aligning engineering, applied science, business teams, and executive leadership around a shared roadmap.

  • A bias toward ownership: you take accountability for outcomes, protect your engineers' focus, and course-correct execution without waiting to be asked.

Mindset

  • Customer-first: you translate needs into technical requirements, push back when scope dilutes value, and advocate relentlessly for the people who use your platform.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: you structure complex problems, propose pilots to validate direction, and create clarity for new and evolving teams.

  • AI intuition: you stay current on models, frameworks, and evaluation methods — not as a researcher, but with the hands-on curiosity of a builder.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

Project Manager

Location: Alkmaar, Netherlands
Working Arrangement: 5 Days Onsite, Alkmaar Office

Join Our Team as a Project Manager at Beyond Sports

If you’re someone who thrives on bringing people, technology, and clients together, enjoys taking ownership of projects from start to finish, and gets energy from delivering high-quality digital products, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

At Beyond Sports, you’ll work on innovative consumer-facing products and experiences within the sports world, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to turn ideas and client requirements into successful deliveries.

What Your Day Will Look Like

As a Project Manager within the Beyond Sports Delivery Team, you’ll be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of consumer-facing software projects, including websites, mobile applications, data visualizations, and other digital sports experiences.

You’ll take ownership of scoping, planning, budgeting, and project delivery, while making sure projects stay on track and meet the quality our clients and users expect. You’ll work closely with our Design, Engineering, and QA teams, facilitating collaboration and ensuring everyone has the clarity they need to deliver successfully.

You’ll also be a key point of contact for our external clients. From translating customer requirements and feedback into clear scopes, functional requirements, and user stories to managing expectations, risks, and project progress, you’ll make sure communication stays clear throughout the entire project lifecycle.

When our products go live, you’ll be there too, acting as a central point of communication and helping coordinate and escalate where necessary during live events.

What We Value

At Beyond Sports, we value people who take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable working in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

As a Project Manager, you’ll need to be proactive and organised, while also being able to adapt your approach depending on the project, client, and team you’re working with. You should be comfortable managing several projects at once and confident bringing together different perspectives to keep everyone moving towards the same goal.

We’re looking for someone who understands the world of technology and software development and can comfortably translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience working with data-driven products or projects is particularly valuable for this role.

While this role is based in Alkmaar, Netherlands, we believe in the power of in-person collaboration, so we expect you to be available for 32–40 hours per week in the office.

Skills and Experience

You don’t need to tick every box, but here’s what we’re looking for:

  • Proven experience managing software or digital projects from start to finish, ideally including consumer-facing products such as websites, mobile applications, or data visualization products

  • Experience with project scoping, planning, budgeting, and resource coordination

  • Strong understanding of software development processes and working with multidisciplinary teams across Design, Engineering, and QA

  • Experience translating customer requirements and feedback into clear scopes, functional requirements, and user stories

jobs.title: Product Owner Cloud Competence Center
jobs.description:
Bouw mee aan het cloudplatform waarop heel Univé draait.

Wie ben jij

Jij bent een ervaren Product Owner die strategisch denken combineert met technische diepgang.

  • Minimaal 3–5 jaar ervaring als Product Owner in een complexe IT omgeving.

  • Je beheerst de volledige product lifecycle.

  • Sterk in stakeholdermanagement en besluitvaardig in complexe domeinen.

  • Begrip van landing zones, networking, identity, CI/CD, security baselines.

  • Kunt technische afhankelijkheden doorgronden en vertalen naar backlogitems.

  • Kennis van cloud governance, FinOps, compliance en platformprincipes.

  • Ervaring met aansturen van externe partners (zoals MSP).

  • Je brengt structuur in multidisciplinaire samenwerking.

  • Ervaring met Agile (Scrum/SAFe), story slicing, acceptance criteria.

  • Sterke schriftelijke en visuele communicatieskills voor roadmap en value cases.

  • HBO/WO niveau, bij voorkeur in IT of bedrijfskunde.

  • Continue verbeter mindset en plezier in rol als challenger en verbinder.

Wat ga je doen

Als Product Owner van het CCC ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen business, productteams, architectuur, security en de MSP. Jij vertaalt de visie naar waardevolle platformdiensten, bepaalt prioriteiten op basis van risico, waarde en technische haalbaarheid, en zorgt dat het cloudplatform continu doorontwikkeld wordt. Je combineert strategische keuzes met voldoende technische diepgang om te begrijpen wát er nodig is voor een state‑of‑the‑art cloudomgeving — en waarom.
 

Jouw rol
 

Als Product Owner binnen het CCC:

  • geef je richting aan de doorontwikkeling van het Univé‑cloudplatform op basis van de CCC‑visie en het Cloud Capability Model;

  • werk je nauw samen met architectuur, security en de MSP om standaarden, kaders en guardrails te definiëren en te bewaken;

  • zorg je voor een scherpe, realistische en waarde‑gedreven roadmap voor platformdiensten, automatisering, beveiliging en landing zones;

  • maak je keuzes die bijdragen aan standaardisatie, toekomstbestendigheid en veilige autonomie van productteams;

  • prioriteer je de backlog in balans tussen innovatie, betrouwbaarheid, vervolgtechniek en compliance;

  • fungeer je als sparringpartner voor engineers, architecten en de MSP;

  • borg je dat nieuwe cloudcapaciteiten voldoen aan ontwerpprincipes, governance‑richtlijnen en security‑eisen;

  • stimuleer je kennisdeling en samenwerking binnen Univé. 

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden


Strategie & Roadmap

  • vertalen van de CCC‑visie naar een concrete productstrategie;

  • opstellen en bewaken van de roadmap voor platformdiensten, automatisering, landing zones en PaaS‑diensten;

Samenwerking & Regie

  • voeren van regie op de MSP en bewaken van kwaliteit, volwassenheid en doorontwikkeling;

  • afstemmen met architectuur, security, servicemanagement en productteams;

Techniek & Inhoud

  • begrijpen van centrale cloudcomponenten zoals landing zones, netwerken, security‑baselines, automatisering en containerplatformen;

  • doorvertalen van technische kaders naar backlogitems;

Governance & Kwaliteit

  • waarborgen van compliance, standaardisatie en veilige cloudadoptie binnen Univé;

  • monitoren van platformprestaties en servicekwaliteit. 

Wat bieden wij

  • een sleutelrol binnen het Cloud Competence Center;

  • ruimte om te pionieren en professionaliseren;

  • afwisseling tussen architectuur en hands‑on engineering;

  • collega’s die voor kwaliteit en eenvoud gaan;

  • een moderne omgeving waar cloud, automatisering en security topprioriteit zijn

Bij Univé IT bieden we je een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische organisatie. De salarisrange ligt tussen € 64.830,24 en € 93.155,08 bruto per jaar op basis van een 38-urige werk-week (inclusief vakantiegeld, een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning).

De belangrijkste arbeidsvoorwaarden op een rijtje:

 

  • je krijgt een prima salaris, afhankelijk van je opleiding, ervaring en competenties;

  • 13e maand;

  • 8% vakantiegeld variabele Collectieve Prestatie Beloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris;

  • arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd;

  • 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek;

  • goede studiekostenregeling;

  • prima pensioenvoorziening;

  • reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en een thuiswerkvergoeding;

  • en natuurlijk: korting op je schade- en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé.

Het team heeft een fijne werkplek in Zwolle, vlakbij het station. In overleg met het team behoort 2-3 dagen thuiswerken tot de mogelijkheden. 

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dicht bij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie. 

Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé.  

Drie focusgebieden 
 

De IT-organisatie is  ingericht met drie primaire afdelingen op de focusgebieden Kern, Data en Distributie. De CIO Office biedt ondersteuning door richting en houvast te geven aan strategische doelen en kaders. De afdeling IT Kern levert een state of the art IT-fundament voor de Univé-organisatie om de businessdoelen te realiseren: betrouwbaar en efficiënt en met een perfecte performance. De afdeling IT Kern bestaat uit vier teams:
 

  • Services – werkplekdiensten, 1e lijns gebruikersondersteuning, Proces- & Servicemanagement en consultancy

  • Frontend Platform – applicatiemanagement van platformen die vooral het contact met onze leden ondersteunen zoals onze online omgeving, CRM en telefonie

  • Backend Platform – applicatiemanagement van platformen die vooral ‘de achterkant processen’ ondersteunen zoals de polis-, claim- en financiële administratie

  • Infra & Security Platform – Cloud Competence Center en operationele security activiteiten

Binnen Infra en Security Platform zijn we op zoek naar een Cloud Specialist voor het Cloud Competence Center die ons verder helpt de professionalisering van ons cloudlandschap te realiseren.
 

Het Cloud Competence Center (CCC) binnen Univé is dé centrale plek waar cloudexpertise, innovatiekracht en toekomstbestendige standaarden samenkomen. Vanuit dit regie‑ en kenniscentrum ondersteunen wij de hele organisatie bij veilig, efficiënt en schaalbaar cloudgebruik. Om onze ambities verder vorm te geven, zoeken wij een veelzijdige Cloud Specialist — een professional die zich thuis voelt in een multidisciplinaire rol en energie krijgt van zowel strategisch ontwerpen als hands‑on realiseren.

Om deze beweging verder vorm te geven zoeken we een Product Owner die zowel strategisch richting geeft als diep genoeg in de materie kan duiken om het cloudplatform inhoudelijk te sturen.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

In this role, you will be responsible for leading and overseeing programs with OEM customers, spanning from early-stage advanced development initiatives to full-scale production programs. You will collaborate closely with the customer to define and manage project plans, ensuring that requirements are seamlessly integrated into the internal development pipeline and delivered on schedule. A deep understanding of the automotive industry and the development of embodied AI systems is essential to effectively guide these programs, identify and report potential risks, and implement a robust change management. You will be at the forefront of delivering meaningful impact to real-world customers.

 

🙌 You should apply if

Essential

  • Extensive program management experience in complex automotive software development.

  • Proficient in utilising program management tools (e.g., Jira) to optimise workflow efficiency and ensure seamless project execution.

  • Robust technical expertise with comprehensive knowledge of the automotive industry and software development.

  • A proactive problem-solving mindset.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

  • Willingness to travel as needed.

Desirable

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Product manager - gestion des projets (CDI)
jobs.description:
🧱 À propos de Bricks

Chez Bricks, on construit la façon la plus simple d’investir dans l’immobilier, à partir de 10 €. 670 000+ membres, un produit régulé (PSFP) et une même exigence sur toute l’expérience : permettre d’investir simplement mais aussi de suivre son investissement dans la durée.

Bricks est une plateforme à deux faces : d’un côté les investisseurs, de l’autre les porteurs de projets immobiliers. Deux communautés à accompagner et faire grandir en parallèle.

Ce qui se passe après le financement d’un projet compte donc autant que le moment où l’on investit : qualité de l’information, transparence, suivi des projets et gestion des situations plus complexes participent directement à l’expérience des deux côtés de la plateforme.

Quelques jalons d’une aventure assez unique : passage chez Capital (M6) en 2022, Tony Parker investisseur et ambassadeur, record européen de vitesse de levée : 5 M€ en 5 secondes, 20 M€+ en 10 jours auprès de notre communauté.

Côté business : 176 M€ collectés en 2025, +90 % en un an et la rentabilité atteinte. Notre prochain enjeu : scaler à grande échelle sans perdre la vélocité qui fait aujourd’hui partie de notre manière de travailler.

Chez Bricks, on attend de chacun qu’il comprenne vraiment les problèmes avant de chercher à les résoudre. L’objectif : prendre les bonnes décisions et construire des solutions utiles.

Sur ce poste, ton travail aura un impact direct sur la qualité du suivi des projets et sur la confiance des investisseurs comme des porteurs de projets.

Vos missions

🧩 Le job

Tu rejoins la squad gestion des projets qui est en charge de tout ce qui se passe après le financement d’un projet immobilier.

Aujourd’hui, Bricks gère environ 400 projets financés simultanément. Pour chacun d’eux, il faut suivre ce qui se passe sur le terrain : récupérer les bonnes informations auprès des porteurs de projets, communiquer régulièrement avec les investisseurs et lorsque quelque chose se passe moins bien, il faut savoir gérer les impayés, les pénalités et les éventuelles procédures de contentieux.

C’est aussi ce qui fait de la gestion post-financement l’un des sujets les plus stratégiques pour Bricks. Une plateforme d’investissement ne se construit pas uniquement au moment où un utilisateur décide d’investir : elle se construit dans la durée, dans la qualité du suivi et dans la façon dont les situations plus complexes sont prises en charge.

Le challenge n’est pas simplement de “gérer 400 projets”. Il est de construire un système capable d’en gérer demain beaucoup plus sans faire grossir l’équipe au même rythme.

Une plateforme existe déjà et accompagne l’équipe au quotidien. Elle a atteint un niveau de maturité où les prochains problèmes ne se résoudront pas uniquement avec de nouvelles features : parfois la meilleure réponse sera produit, parfois process, parfois automatisation, parfois juridique.

C’est là que tu interviens.

👉 Ce que tu vas owner

  • Comprendre profondément le quotidien des utilisateurs internes en particulier celui de la personne qui opère nos projets au quotidien : observer, écouter, identifier les irritants et comprendre ce qui peut être supprimé, automatisé ou mieux structuré.
  • Faire évoluer la gestion de plusieurs centaines de projets pour qu’elle reste fluide et scalable : priorisation, automatisation, workflows, process et outils.
  • Travailler avec l’engineering pour transformer les problèmes identifiés en solutions produit lorsqu’une solution technique est pertinente.
  • Aller chercher l’information là où elle se trouve : care, juridique, marketing, métier, engineering… Tu ne travailles pas à partir d’une spec parfaite, tu reconstruis toi-même le contexte.
  • T’approprier des sujets parfois complexes ou réglementaires. Tu n’as pas besoin d’être juriste, mais un contrat de 50 pages ou une discussion sur un process de contentieux ne doit pas te faire fuir.
  • Choisir le bon levier plutôt que la feature par défaut : modifier un process peut parfois avoir plus d’impact que développer un nouvel écran.
  • Transformer chaque problème rencontré en apprentissage réutilisable : l’objectif n’est pas de traiter le problème du projet n°237, mais de faire en sorte qu’il soit mieux géré pour les centaines de projets suivants.
  • Et progressivement, prendre de plus en plus d’ownership sur la stratégie et la roadmap de la squad. Le périmètre pourra évoluer fortement selon ce que tu démontres sur le terrain.

👥 La squad

Tu travailleras au quotidien avec les équipes en charge du suivi opérationnel des projets ainsi qu’avec l'Engineering, le Product, le Growth et Marketing.

Selon les sujets, tu seras également amené à collaborer avec le Care, le juridique ou la direction. Un même problème peut avoir des conséquences très différentes selon les équipes et les utilisateurs concernés.

C’est un rôle où la collaboration compte énormément. Ton travail ne consiste pas simplement à recueillir les besoins de chacun et à les transformer en features.

Tu dois aller chercher l’information directement auprès des personnes concernées, comprendre leur réalité opérationnelle, croiser les différents points de vue et remonter à la vraie problématique derrière une demande.

Ce qu’un utilisateur te demande n’est pas toujours la solution dont il a besoin. À toi d’agréger le contexte, de challenger les demandes et de construire avec l’équipe la réponse la plus efficace qu’elle soit produit, process, technique ou juridique.

Vos compétences

🎯 Tu fitteras si

  • Tu as au moins 3 ans d’expérience en Product Management avec déjà une vraie autonomie sur ton périmètre.
  • Tu as déjà travaillé sur un produit ou un environnement où il fallait comprendre le métier avant de construire la solution. Tu vas spontanément parler aux utilisateurs plutôt que d’attendre qu’un besoin parfaitement formulé arrive jusqu’à toi. C’est un point particulièrement important pour ce rôle.
  • Tu es à l’aise dans des environnements mouvants. Tu peux passer plusieurs jours à creuser un problème complexe, puis devoir jongler entre plusieurs sujets dans la même journée. Tu sais récupérer rapidement le contexte, identifier ce qui compte et avancer sans te perdre dans l’information
  • Tu as un vrai mindset builder/entrepreneur : tu n’as pas besoin que tout soit déjà structuré pour commencer à avancer.
  • Tu sais travailler avec des experts sans avoir besoin de devenir toi-même expert de chaque sujet. Tu peux échanger avec un juriste, un développeur, le care ou le marketing, absorber leur contexte et transformer tout ça en décisions produit cohérentes.
  • Tu sais défendre un point de vue et challenger quand c’est nécessaire y compris face à des interlocuteurs très seniors, tout en étant capable de changer d’avis quand les arguments sont meilleurs.
  • Une expérience dans un environnement régulé ou à fortes contraintes métier : fintech, legaltech, comptabilité, RH… est un vrai plus. Ici une décision produit peut avoir des conséquences financières, juridiques ou opérationnelles réelles.
  • Tu préfères faire beaucoup avec une petite équipe plutôt que de construire du process pour construire du process

❌ Tu ne fitteras probablement pas si

  • Tu as besoin d’un framework très établi pour fonctionner.
  • Tu attends des specs détaillées avant d’aller chercher toi-même le contexte.
  • Ton premier réflexe face à un problème est systématiquement de créer une feature.
  • Tu cherches à appliquer « la bonne méthode produit » indépendamment du contexte.
  • Tu préfères passer trois semaines à cadrer parfaitement un sujet plutôt que tester rapidement une hypothèse lorsque le risque le permet.
  • Ou tu imagines le rôle de PM comme quelqu’un qui organise le travail d’une squad depuis Jira : ici le Product Manager met vraiment les mains dans le problème.

Avantages

🚀 Pourquoi ce rôle est intéressant

La squad est déjà l’une des plus matures chez Bricks mais le terrain de jeu devant elle reste énorme.

Aujourd’hui, il y a environ 400 projets. Demain, il peut y en avoir 2 000 avec de nouvelles typologies de produits, de nouveaux pays et de nouveaux enjeux réglementaires ou opérationnels. L’objectif n’est pas de construire une organisation lourde pour absorber cette croissance mais bien de trouver une meilleure façon de travailler à chaque étape.

Et à mesure que tu prends ownership du sujet, ton rôle pourra aller bien au-delà de l’exécution d’une roadmap : comprendre suffisamment bien le métier pour contribuer directement aux prochains sujets sur lesquels Bricks doit investir.

L'offre

👉 CDI, temps plein.

👉 De vrais sujets, un vrai impact : produit régulé, vraies conséquences quand on se plante.

👉 Beaucoup d’ownership : tu travailleras directement avec les personnes qui font le produit et tu auras une vraie influence sur ce qu’on construit.

👉Une boîte ambitieuse, rentable et en forte croissance : tu arrives à un moment où l’organisation Product est encore suffisamment petite pour que tu puisses réellement contribuer à la construire.

👉 Salaire compétitif, assurance santé moderne, MacBook Pro de ton choix, tout le matériel qu'il te faut.

👉 Hybride Montpellier : office-first (2j/sem de remote) ou remote-first (~2j/mois au bureau).

Déroulement des entretiens

  1. Pré-qualification téléphonique avec notre recruteuse
  2. Echange métier (1h)
  3. Entretien team-fit (1h)
  4. Rencontre avec Cédric, notre fondateur (45 min)
  5. Offre

We are hiring a Software Engineer (B2B Lending & Payments) to take ownership of the financial infrastructure that powers how our clients finance their assets through INFINIT.

We believe the most resilient lending and payment systems are built by engineers who operate at the intersection of deep technical mastery, genuine product judgment, and direct proximity to the client’s financing workflow. You will work with business stakeholders and clients to understand why a problem matters before deciding what to build then use agentic coding to ship the how fast and well.

Partnering with other engineers owning this domain, you will own two deeply connected responsibilities. First, crafting the best possible experience for a client going through a loan application, from the moment they submit a request to the moment financing is confirmed, every step should feel clear, fast, and trustworthy. Second, ensuring that every payment executed throughout the loan lifecycle (interest accruals, supplier disbursements, reimbursement) is processed correctly, securely, and without exception. You will be the person the rest of the team pings when something in this domain breaks.

Product Manager - Trust & Safety (Full Remote - Netherlands)
jobs.description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

We are looking for a Trust & Safety Product Manager to own the product and technical delivery of our compliance and safety initiatives across our platforms.

You will turn safety requirements into effective product features, moderation capabilities, third-party integrations, and measurable improvements. Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform.

This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our CTO, Michael Monin and our Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol. You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow.

Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression.

Here’s what you can expect:

Key Responsibilities

  • Safety & legal product strategy and delivery. Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement.

  • Internally developed moderation technologies. Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on, e.g., detection capabilities, moderation rules and thresholds, and appropriate interventions across user inputs and AI-generated outputs.

  • Third-party safety partnerships and integrations. Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management.

  • Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance. Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended.

  • Red teaming and adversarial testing. Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report.

  • Trust and safety reviews for new features. Establish and run a dedicated T&S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations. Engage early in product design to identify foreseeable misuse, affected users, and appropriate safeguards.

  • Incident follow-through and continuous improvement. Coordinate the product and engineering response to significant safety issues, working with colleagues responsible for incident management, policy, and user support.

Learn more about our Trust & Safety infrastructure in our Trust & Safety Hub.

Your Qualifications

  • Data-driven product decisions that align with legal/ethical standards: You can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next. You can assess risks associated with user-generated content, transactions, and interactions, and translate these into policies that align with legal and ethical standards, trackers/dashboards, and strategic planning;

  • Content moderation and AI guardrails: You understand how product realities and safety requirements interact on a tech platform; you explore strategies for efficient and scalable content moderation, including automation, machine learning, human review and user reporting.

  • Legal/safety work experience: You have worked closely with trust and safety and compliance requirements and understand how to translate and implement these for a consumer-facing product;

  • Collaborative mindset and communication: You work cross-functionally with engineering, legal, operations, and customer support teams — these are your partners and support system, not your adversaries or a box to be checked. You ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and are fully fluent and comfortable in English;

  • AI fluency: You are completely comfortable working with and leveraging AI tools. You actively seek out and experiment with new tools and techniques without waiting for a project or manager to require them;

  • You are point person for third-party partnerships: You proactively test and can autonomously handle discussions with third-party tools and integrations that affect our compliance and safety posture;

  • You take ownership and move without waiting for certainty: Comfortable with ambiguity, you create clarity by investigating, building, testing, and learning rather than waiting for a complete brief. You balance execution against planning, address blockers early, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting to be told what to do, caring more about reaching the right result than following a fixed process;

  • You are comfortable with the product category: you are fully comfortable building products based on uncensored models and content;

Bonus points

  • You have previous legal/compliance education

  • Professional experience or interest in AI

  • Experience with consumer-facing features, particularly in the entertainment or gaming industry

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and need people who can balance execution, planning, and strategy

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - Comfortable reviewing and discussing uncensored AI-generated content and NSFW material

We believe strongly that information can be learned, but effort and motivation cannot. If this role appeals to you but you don’t have hands-on experience in all the fields listed in this job description, apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a good fit!

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

Compensation: $95K – $125K

jobs.description:
Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform driving digital commerce across the globe. By offering a fully integrated solution, we empower marketers, online stores, and digital agencies to manage, scale, and optimize their online activities.

As the market leader in the Benelux, we owe our success to an incredible product, a passionate team ánd our customers who love working with us! To keep winning, our Benelux region is split into two specialized teams (Strategic and Growth), working closely together.  This opening is within the CS Benelux Strategic team.

Your role in a nutshell: you'll own Channable's most strategic Benelux relationships: (inter)national brands with digital marketing teams in the region, and our biggest Agency Partners (Gold & Silver). You'll work with senior specialists, marketing leads, heads of e-commerce, and decision-makers to understand what their business is trying to achieve this year and how their digital marketing team is measured against it. From there, you find where Channable can drive the outcomes that get them closer to those goals. When your clients win, and Channable is a part of that, we grow together, and that growth is yours to own.


Here's what that looks like day-to-day:

  • Business-goal alignment and planning: understanding each client's and/or agency's annual objectives and how their digital marketing team contributes to them, then translating that into a strategic success plan with outcomes both sides can measure.

  • Stakeholder management & multi-threading: building and maintaining relationships across the whole account, from hands-on specialists to executive sponsors, so no relationship rests on a single contact.

  • Strategic cadence: kick-offs, Impact Reviews, realizing success plans with outcome-driven and goal-focused metrics, check-ins, demos, hosting trainings, and commercially led meetings, online and onsite, in the market.

  • Portfolio & account ownership: retention, expansion and net new MRR across a named set of top-tier accounts; identifying risk early, preventing churn and downgrades; pipeline creation and forecasting.

  • Voice of the customer: running trainings and enablement for large advertisers and partner teams, feeding client insight back to product and commercial, and turning your strongest accounts into webinars, success stories and references.

  • Raising the bar: contributing to how we manage the strategic segment, account plans, risk signals, expansion playbooks, and Customer Success processes.

What you bring:

  • You have 3+ years' experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Partnership Management, or a similar client-facing commercial role, with a track record on large or complex accounts. Experience on the other side of the table, at a marketing agency or in-house at a brand, counts fully.

  • You build relationships across an organisation, from hands-on specialists to senior decision-makers, and you're willing to challenge a client when their plan won't get them where they say they want to go.

  • You've carried a commercial target, and you know how to plan towards it rather than hope for it.

  • You understand online marketing well enough to hold a credible conversation with a performance marketing lead.

  • Not a must, but a strong plus: experience on the client side, at a marketing agency or in an in-house digital marketing team (preferably e-commerce)

  • You have at least a completed HBO education - for example, in the direction of commercial economics, (international) business, marketing, or hospitality.

  • Your language skills include excellent written and spoken Dutch (C2)  and English at a C1 level.

Other requirements:

  • You are living in The Netherlands with travel distance from our Utrecht office.

  • You are willing to come to our Utrecht office for 2 days/week, preferably more.

  • You are available to travel and visit clients.

  • You are available for at least 32 hours per week (4 days).

  • You have a valid work permit for the Netherlands or EU citizenship.

  • Not a must, but a strong plus: experience on the client side, at a marketing agency or in an in-house digital marketing team (preferably e-commerce)

Who are we?

Being part of our team means working with diverse and fun people who trust and help you along the way. Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals, more than +40 nationalities, and a brand new and vibrant HQ in Utrecht, serving customers all over the globe. We're also operating from other offices including New York City, Berlin, and Aarhus.

Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. We like spending time with each other. Be that in the office, our Channabar, or in one of our internal chats. We’re open-minded and down-to-earth people. We’re super proud that everyone adds their own special spice to Channable’s culture. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at our Instagram, Facebook or LinkedIn! Give our Culture Playbook a read.

What do we do?

Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing.

What do we offer?

The OTE salary ranges from €3.650 to €5.000 gross per month based on a 40-hour workweek. OTE (On Target Earnings) consists of 80% gross base salary and 20% commission (paid out quarterly). A breakdown of this structure is provided below:

  • Base salary: The base salary is gross between €3.650 and €5.000 (80%) per month based on a 40-hour workweek. The salary is determined based on experience.

  • Performance bonus: 20% performance bonus is gross between €915 and €1.250 (20%) per month based on a 40-hour workweek.

  • 8% holiday allowance - 8% of your yearly salary, which is paid together with the May salary.

  • Annual L&D budget of € 1000 to spend on anything you want to learn. You can take full advantage of this to grow professionally.

  • Saving for old age - we have a saving scheme for old age which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary.

  • Traveling to our office? No problem, we got you covered. (NS Business Card, or €0,25 per km if you decide to use a different means of transport) 🚆

  • Our beautiful, fully renovated historic office in central Utrecht offers a hybrid working policy, requiring just two days in the office per week.

  • Since you can work from home, we will provide home office supplies. 🖥️⌨️

  • 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours.

  • We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks, if you live as an expat in the Netherlands! 🍹

  • Having flexible working hours means starting your day between 8.00 - 10.00 am. 🕰️

  • We want you to feel good - please feel free to use our discounted Urban Sports Club subscription.

  • You have free & anonymous access to the OpenUp platform and psychologists. This free service is also available to your family members.

  • Are you going to become a parent? We think it is important that you spend time with your newborn. Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave!

To round out the week, Fridays feature delicious ordered-in sandwiches and salads. Or, you can go to the city center to get the lunch of your choice.

  • Additional working conditions like massages, in-office bar (Channabar), parties, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, and many more!

Are you interested? Please apply by clicking on the "apply now" button below. Please send your application in English.

Interview steps:

  1. If it's a match, our Talent Acquisition Team will get in touch with you for an introduction call (25 minutes).

  4. Please note that after the interviews and before the offer stage, we’ll conduct reference checks.

We consider applications as they come in. We look forward to hearing from you!

*Contact by job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 for Make-A-Wish.

jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

As Staff AI Deployment Strategist, you will shape how some of the most ambitious enterprises in the UK & Nordics region adopt frontier AI at scale.

This is a senior, high-impact role at the intersection of strategy, technology, and execution. You will work directly on Mistral’s most strategic opportunities and largest deliveries, helping customers move from ambition to measurable business outcomes. You will frame complex AI transformation programs, turn executive priorities into actionable roadmaps, and ensure that Mistral delivers systems that are valuable, scalable, and trusted.

You will also act as a senior sponsor on our most critical customer programs, bringing judgment, structure, and delivery excellence to high-stakes engagements. Your mandate is to raise the ambition and quality of AI adoption: helping customers identify where AI can create step-change value, making the right trade-offs, and ensuring that execution matches the strategic promise.

This role is ideal for an experienced strategy consultant, transformation leader, or senior operator who wants to move from advising on change to building it directly with frontier AI technology.

 

What You Will Do

  • Shape high-impact AI transformations

    • Partner closely with Mistral’s Sales leadership in the UK & Nordics to qualify opportunities, align on account strategy, and drive executive engagement.

    • Structure complex opportunities into clear, credible, and executable transformation programs.

    • Translate strategic ambition into delivery roadmaps, success metrics, and operating plans.

    • Help customers make the right trade-offs between ambition, feasibility, speed, and long-term scalability.

    • Ensure delivery quality, executive alignment, and measurable business impact.

    • Anticipate risks, unblock decisions, and help teams navigate ambiguity in high-stakes environments.

    • Bring senior judgment to moments where scope, resources, timelines, or expected value need to be clarified.

  • Build repeatable deployment excellence

    • Turn lessons from strategic engagements into reusable approaches, playbooks, and patterns.

    • Raise the bar for how AI programs are qualified, framed, delivered, and scaled.

    • Act as a senior relay for the Solutions organization in the region, helping teams adopt shared best practices, adapt them thoughtfully to local market specificities when needed, and strengthen the quality of execution.

    • Work hand in hand with Solutions leadership to connect customer realities, delivery patterns, and field feedback into practical ways of improving how Mistral deploys AI.

    • Help codify what great enterprise AI deployment looks like across industries and use cases.

    • Contribute to a Solutions culture that combines strategic clarity, technical depth, and strong execution.

  • Develop and multiply senior DS impact

    • Coach Deployment Strategists on strategic problem-solving, executive communication, and delivery leadership.

    • Help teams raise the quality of their work on the highest-impact opportunities.

    • Identify capability gaps and contribute to hiring, staffing, and development priorities.

    • Act as a force multiplier across accounts, teams, and regions where your experience can have the highest leverage.

 
 

What We're Looking For

 

You are a senior, highly capable professional with strong executive presence, excellent business judgment, and a track record of leading complex strategic or transformation work.

Typical indicators we’re looking for include:

  • 8–10+ years of professional experience in strategy consulting, digital transformation, AI, enterprise technology, or a similarly demanding environment.

  • Experience operating at Partner, Principal, Engagement Manager, Director, or equivalent level in a top-tier strategy consulting or transformation context.

  • A strong ability to structure ambiguous problems, identify value, and turn strategy into execution.

  • Experience leading large accounts, complex programs, or senior customer relationships.
