  • Strong analytical and commercial judgment, with the ability to challenge assumptions constructively.

  • Comfort working at the frontier of technology, even when solutions are evolving quickly and the path is not fully defined.

We are looking for a Client Partner to join our Public Sector team

A bit about Torchbox
We build digital products for international NGOs, governments and universities; and we created Wagtail CMS, used by Google, NASA, the NHS and thousands more. 

Our diverse team of over 120 people is mostly UK-based but with a significant presence in Manila as well as a network of people around the world.

We are on a mission to set a new standard for a purpose-led business. Torchbox is 100% employee-owned - everyone is a co-owner from day one and we are building an amazing, progressive ownership and learning culture. If you are excited about this mission, it’s a great time to join.


What we’re looking for

We are seeking an experienced Client Partner to join our team. Your experience might be in Product or Service Ownership, Delivery Management, or Consulting with a digital agency. 

While account management experience is useful, we are particularly looking for candidates with client-side public sector experience, particularly in navigating complex digital projects and helping clients implement the government Service Standard. You’ll have strong experience in helping clients develop and implement effective digital services and interventions.
We recognise that candidates may not have deep expertise in every aspect of the role, so we’re open to different backgrounds. Whether you lean more towards Delivery or Product is less important than your ability to build strong relationships, guide clients through challenges, and contribute to sales efforts.

In this role, progression will be about the complexity and scale of projects and clients rather than a traditional management track. 

We’re generally a curious, creative, and caring team. If you’re passionate about helping public sector clients navigate complex challenges, improve services, and create meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you!


You will:

  • User-centred and agile working: create the conditions for collaborative, multidisciplinary work across research, design, innovation, and enabling technology. 


Skills & Experience

  • Strong understanding of Service Standard approaches, user-centred design disciplines, and iterative working methods.

  • Experience in a Product, Delivery, or Service Lead role with a focus on agile, user-centred service and product development.

  • Ability to build trust and long-term relationships with public sector clients.

  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, with confidence in presenting to clients and stakeholders.

  • Comfortable working in a sales-involved role, identifying opportunities and supporting business growth.

  • A results-oriented mindset, with a track record of driving impactful digital projects.


What we offer

  • Become a co-owner of Torchbox, shape our success and share in the rewards 

  • Work with awesome clients doing rewarding, purposeful work

  • Competitive salary + annual review + bonuses

  • Ethical pension scheme, with a 6% contribution from Torchbox

The money bit

jobs.title: Ingénieur·e Logiciel Embarqué
jobs.description:
QUI SOMMES-NOUS ?

Smart Impulse c'est l'histoire d'un projet de fin d'études qui se transforme en un projet entrepreneurial ambitieux et engagé !

C'est en 2011 que Charles et Henri, nos deux fondateurs, se lancent le défi de révolutionner la gestion de l'Énergie dans les bâtiments.

Plus concrètement, nous concevons et développons des solutions de mesure électrique nouvelle génération avec un compteur électrique, le Smart X, simple à installer (moins d'une heure, sans outil et sans coupure), permettant, à partir d'un seul point de mesure et d'algorithmes brevetés (Nonintrusive Load Monitoring - NILM), d'identifier la consommation de chaque type d'équipements dans un bâtiment (éclairage, chauffage, informatique, ventilation, etc.).

L'analyse des données récoltées permet aux gestionnaires de bâtiments tertiaires d'identifier des leviers d'économie et ainsi maîtriser et optimiser la consommation d'énergie.

Aujourd'hui, nos solutions sont déployées dans plus de 4000 bâtiments répartis dans 60 pays dans le monde.

Rejoignez notre équipe de plus de 60 Impulsers qui participent au quotidien à façonner l'avenir de l'innovation énergétique !

LE CONTEXTE

Afin d'accélérer notre croissance, nous recherchons un·e Ingénieur·e Logiciel Embarqué pour nous permettre de lancer le développement de la prochaine génération de notre compteur intelligent - avec l'ambition de faire du hardware un avantage concurrentiel durable pour Smart Impulse.

Rattaché·e au Hardware Manager, au sein de la Feature Team Hardware composée d'un manager hands-on (Mathieu, votre futur responsable) et d'un Ingénieur Logiciel Embarqué (Gordon), vous contribuerez principalement au développement logiciel de la prochaine génération de notre compteur.

À partir d'une page quasi blanche, l'enjeu sera de concevoir un compteur permettant de proposer des solutions toujours plus adaptées aux besoins de nos clients, alignées avec les market standards (self-service, métrologie, cybersécurité, certifications, gestion de flotte, etc.) et d'augmenter les capacités de nos algorithmes (Edge AI).

VOS MISSIONS

Au quotidien, vos principales missions seront les suivantes :

Conception logicielle

  • Participer à la définition de la nouvelle génération de compteurs intelligents
  • Concevoir des architectures logicielles fiables reposant sur votre expertise passée (découpage en couches, machines à états, design patterns, etc.)

Développement logiciel embarqué

  • Développer le logiciel embarqué de la nouvelle génération de compteurs intelligents sur cible microcontrôleur
  • Maintenir et enrichir les tests unitaires nécessaires à la qualité du développement logiciel (CI/CD, pipelines)
  • Participer aux revues techniques intra-équipe
  • Participer ponctuellement au support des produits existants (Smart X, routeurs OpenWRT)

Développement software et outils

  • Contribuer au développement des outils que la Feature Team met à disposition des autres équipes
  • Développer les outils nécessaires aux tests qualité et à la mise en production de nos produits (bancs de production)

Documentation

  • Rédiger des documentations internes claires au niveau de détail approprié (README, changelog, base de connaissance, Merge Request, communications internes) en lien avec vos développements logiciels
  • Suivre et mettre à jour les tickets de développement sur lesquels vous travaillez

NOS OUTILS ET TECHNOLOGIES

Outils

  • Développement : Jira, Git/GitLab
  • Monitoring et data : Grafana, Dataiku, Metabase
  • LLM : Claude (Claude Code), CodeRabbit (revue de code)

Technologies

  • Cibles hardware : MCU ARM, STM32, ESP
  • Développement embarqué : C/C++, Rust, ESP-IDF, Python
  • Temps réel : FreeRTOS
  • Connectivité : Wi-Fi/LAN, 4G
  • Langages d'outils/scripts : Python / Bash
  • Backend : Python (Django)

L'IMPULSEUR·EUSE QU'IL NOUS FAUT

Formation & Expérience

  • Bac +5 ou supérieur, école d'ingénieurs ou filière universitaire
  • Vous avez un minimum de 5 années d'expérience et justifiez d'une expérience réussie sur du développement logiciel embarqué sur cible microcontrôleur, idéalement dans un environnement start-up/scale-up

Compétences

  • Vous savez rédiger des spécifications techniques logicielles à partir d'un cadrage fonctionnel réalisé par notre Product Manager Hardware
  • Vous savez architecturer vos développements logiciels (découpage couche par couche, drivers, machines à états, etc.) et êtes en mesure de mettre votre expertise au profit d'un logiciel de qualité
  • Vous connaissez les méthodes de développement du type Test Driven Development (TDD) et avez idéalement une expérience de développement de tests virtuels par émulation (QEMU) et de simulation Hardware-in-the-loop
  • Vous connaissez les ressorts spécifiques au développement temps réel (gestion de la concurrence, programmation asynchrone, interruptions, DMA, etc.) et avez une solide compréhension du fonctionnement et des périphériques d'un microcontrôleur (contraintes RAM/FLASH, SPI, UART, etc.) ainsi que de certains bus de terrain (Ethernet, Modbus, etc.)
  • Vous avez de bonnes connaissances en réseaux informatiques et cybersécurité (chiffrement, secure boot, etc.)
  • Vous faites un bon usage des outils IA d'assistance de code
  • Idéalement, vous avez de bonnes connaissances Linux et API web
  • Vous avez de bonnes compétences en communication (orale et écrite) pour une collaboration efficace
  • Vous parlez et écrivez un anglais professionnel

Savoir-être

  • Vous êtes orienté·e solution et innovation et êtes d'un naturel proactif
  • Vous êtes autonome, méthodique, organisé·e et rigoureux·se, vous avez le goût du travail bien fait
  • Véritable team player, vous savez collaborer et mener des projets en équipe, avec un état d'esprit positif, enthousiaste et bienveillant
  • Vous êtes engagé·e dans une formation continue pour rester à jour sur les tendances du secteur et les nouvelles technologies

Côté avantages, voici ce que nous vous proposons :

Les classiques …

  • Des titres-restaurant pour vos déjeuners (Merci Swile ! )
  • Une mutuelle d'entreprise plutôt sympa (Merci Malakoff Humanis ! )
  • Le remboursement de 75 % de vos frais de transport en commun (Plutôt vélo ? On a aussi ce qu'il vous faut !)

Les petits plus …

  • Une politique de télétravail hybride (2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine)
  • Un accès à une cafétéria d'entreprise
  • Un Comité des Fêtes qui nous concocte des événements et des activités diverses et variées
  • Des séances de sport organisées chaque semaine (foot, badminton et escalade)
  • Des locaux entièrement végétalisés (parce que c'est bon pour le corps et pour l'esprit ! )

Rejoindre Smart Impulse c'est :

  • Participer au développement d'une entreprise innovante avec une mission porteuse de sens

jobs.title: Senior iOS Developer (Remote)
jobs.description:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

The Role

For hundreds of thousands of European entrepreneurs, our iOS app is Finom. It's how they check their cash flow over morning coffee, approve a payment between client meetings, and freeze a card the moment something looks off. We're mobile-first by conviction, not convenience — the app isn't a companion to the "real" product; it is the product. And as an AI-native platform, the features you build increasingly carry intelligence inside them: AI-powered accounting, smart categorization, and agentic workflows that quietly save business owners hours every week. When you ship something great, someone somewhere feels it the same day.

That's why we're not looking for someone to implement tickets. We're looking for a Senior Mobile (iOS) Engineer who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, challenges assumptions when needed, and proactively spots opportunities to create better outcomes.

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team — Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product — that owns a shared product area end-to-end. No handoff culture, no "not my layer": everyone in the team is solving the same customer problem, and you'll shape solutions from the first product conversation to the moment the feature is live in users' hands. Fewer silos means more flow — and real, end-to-end ownership.

How We Build

Agentic development is table stakes at Finom — for every craft, mobile included. Our engineers work with Claude Code and similar harnesses daily, and we've made it a first-class part of how the company operates, not an individual productivity hack. We follow a shared SDLC approach built around Spec-Driven Development (SDD): features start as clear, reviewable specs that both humans and AI agents execute against, powered by a shared AI development toolbelt and a growing library of skills, rules, and context maintained across guilds. You won't be figuring out AI-assisted development alone — you'll join an engineering organization that has already invested in the infrastructure, standards, and shared practices, and you'll be expected to use them, improve them, and raise the bar for others.


What You'll Do

What You'll Do

  • Design and build new features for our iOS application, used daily by business owners across Europe: multi-account cash flow management, banking transactions and payments, physical and virtual card issuance and control, and AI-powered accounting automation.

  • Own outcomes, not just code. You'll follow your features into analytics, jump into customer issues without being prompted, and care about whether what you shipped actually moved the needle.

  • Build polished, responsive UIs with UIKit and SwiftUI — in a financial app, trust is built (or lost) in the details.

  • Drive technical decisions within your domain, discuss trade-offs openly with product managers, and explain constraints clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Raise the bar on engineering quality — automated testing, thorough code reviews, and mobile security best practices are non-negotiable in a regulated fintech.

  • Mentor the engineers around you and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team.

    •  


Who You Are

Who You Are

You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. Above all, you're curious — about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three.

Curiosity. You want to understand the "why" behind every feature. You ask what problem it solves, question whether there's a simpler path, and explore how your decisions ripple into product, users, and revenue.

Business acumen. You connect your work to company objectives. You understand the "so what" behind every decision, and you'd rather ship the feature that moves the right metric than the one that's merely interesting to build.

Communication. You communicate clearly and concisely in English across technical and non-technical audiences — from fellow engineers to PMs to business stakeholders — and you genuinely enjoy the dynamics of a cross-functional team.

T-shapedness. Your iOS craft runs deep, but your curiosity runs wide. You'll peek at the backend contracts, ask questions about the ML models, and dive into analytics to understand how your features perform.

Ownership. You take responsibility not just for your code, but for the outcomes. You move without being prompted — whether that's improving team processes, jumping on a production issue, or mentoring a colleague.

Your Experience Includes

  • 5+ years of commercial iOS development with strong knowledge of Swift.

  • Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns.

  • Practical experience with the VIPER architectural pattern and the Coordinator navigation pattern — and the judgment to know when a simpler approach serves the product better.

  • Excellent knowledge of UIKit and experience (or a strong desire to grow) with SwiftUI.

  • Experience with layout development in code, particularly using SnapKit or similar tools.

  • Ability to write unit and UI tests.

  • Confidence with Git / GitLab, including setting up and maintaining GitLab CI/CD.

  • Hands-on experience with agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as part of your daily workflow — writing prompts, configuring rules and skills, and critically evaluating AI-generated output with tests, linters, and review. This is table stakes for all engineering crafts at Finom, mobile included.

  • A builder's mentality: you care deeply about shipping great products, not just writing great code.


Nice to Have

Nice to Have

  • Background in fintech or financial products — you understand the stakes of working in a regulated environment.

  • Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain).

  • Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing rendering bottlenecks and hitting smooth 60/120fps on iOS.

  • Hands-on work with performance tooling: Instruments, XCTest, or similar.

  • Published apps on the App Store you're proud of.

  • An active GitHub profile with code you're happy to share.

  • Deeper agentic engineering experience beyond daily tool use — setting up agent environments and harnesses, authoring reusable skills and behavioral rules, or contributing to a team's shared AI development practices.

  • Understanding of model capabilities and limitations — knowing which model fits which task and how to manage the context window effectively.

  • Awareness of AI security risks — prompt injection, data leakage, and safe handling of untrusted inputs in agentic workflows.

Recruitment Flow
  • Recruiter Interview
  • First Technical Interview
  • Coding / AI assisted coding interview
  • Mobile System Design Interview
  • Team Fit Interview (peer interview)
  • Offer

What You Will Get In Return
 
Make a genuine impact on the product
 
Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
 
Work in the EU
 
Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
 
Become a stock options holder
 
Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
 
Receive unwavering support and care
 
Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
 
Work & Swim program
 
Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
 
Equal Opportunity Statement 
 
At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Senior Integrity Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Integrity Engineer

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity.

Your team

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

·        Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it.

·        Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards.

·        Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities.

·        Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions.

·        Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data.

·        Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards.

·        Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early.

What you bring

Must-haves

·        A degree in Mechanical and/or Materials (or Metallurgical) Engineering, ideally a combination of both. A Master's degree is a strong plus.

·        At least 5 years of relevant experience in the structural integrity of pressurised equipment, preferably pipelines, including independently performing and reviewing FFS assessments and remaining life calculations.

·        Strong working knowledge of fracture mechanics and corrosion and fatigue damage mechanisms.

·        Working knowledge of API 579 / ASME FFS-1, API 530, ASME B31G, DNV-RP-F101, API 1183, ASME VIII Div. 2 and ASME PCC-2, and of the international regulations for pipeline and pressure equipment integrity.

·        Experience with risk assessments and turning results into clear, actionable recommendations.

·        Strong mathematics and statistics, including probabilistic methods.

·        Programming skills to solve engineering problems, preferably in Python, VBA or MATLAB.

·        Mid to advanced-level training in integrity assessment methods.

·        You write clear, professional technical reports and explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

·        You work independently with minimal supervision, keep your agreements, and are flexible with working hours to collaborate with colleagues in Canada and Mexico.

·        You are curious, proactive and a team player who suggests improvements to help the team work better and avoid rework.

Nice-to-haves

·        Hands-on experience with finite element analysis (FEA), preferably ABAQUS.

·        Experience with creep assessment of boilers and heaters.

·        Exposure to Level 3 FFS assessments.

·        Experience with pipeline ILI data analysis (MFL/UT).

·        Experience with client-facing technical activities or proposals.

·        Experience in highly regulated industries.

Why Intero

·        Work that makes a difference. Your recommendations directly determine whether critical pipelines and installations can keep operating safely.

·        Variety. Pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers; FFS Level 1 to 3, corrosion growth, dent strain and more, for clients all over the world.

·        Real influence. You help shape the team's methods, procedures and in-house tools, and see your ideas put into practice.

·        International team, flexible set-up. Daily collaboration with colleagues in Canada and Mexico, remote working from Europe, and once or twice a year a visit to our HQ in Tricht.

·        Growth. Within one to three years you can take on a larger share of Run Comparison and FFS reviews and expand into dent strain analysis.

What we offer

·        A contract for 32-40 hours per week.

·        A competitive salary and benefits package, tailored to the country you're based in. Because pay and conditions vary by location, we'll discuss the details with you personally during the process.

·        Remote working from Europe, or hybrid if you live near one of our offices with available space.

·        Flexible start of the day between 6:00 and 10:00, with occasional early or late meetings to overlap with our North American team.


Application process

1. Introductory interview with our recruiter.
2. Technical interview with our Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead.
3. Final interview with Manager and Business Director.
4. Job offer.

We would like the new colleague to start as soon as possible. Interested? Apply via the button below with your CV and a short motivation. For questions, please contact Veroniek Smits, our Corporate Recruiter, at

jobs.description:
We Want You to Grow With Us 

Intersnack is building a next-generation AI and data foundation and this role is at the heart of making that foundation meaningful for the people who rely on it every day. As our AI Engineer for Analytics & End-User Insights, you will bridge the gap between enterprise data architecture and the business users who depend on trustworthy, actionable intelligence to make decisions. You will report into the AI Programme and collaborate across procurement, manufacturing, and sales to deliver AI-powered reporting that business teams can understand, trust, and act on. 

What We Can Offer 

You will join a collaborative, internationally minded team building something genuinely new: a modern, AI-grounded analytics capability that complements existing reporting and serves real business decisions. This role offers significant autonomy to shape how AI is introduced into the daily workflows of colleagues across multiple functions and countries. The impact of your work will be visible and measurable, from the moment a business user receives an AI-generated insight they trust, to the gradual reduction of manual reporting steps that once dominated their week. Dusseldorf serves as your home base, with flexibility for remote working, and the broader Intersnack network gives you exposure to a truly international operating environment. 

How You Will Spend Your Time as Our Next AI Engineer - Analytics & End-User Insights 

You will operate at the intersection of data engineering, AI, and business enablement: designing the data supply chain and semantic infrastructure that makes AI-driven analytics possible, while ensuring that the people who consume those analytics are equipped to use them with confidence. Your focus spans architecture and adoption in equal measure, working closely with business stakeholders to define what good looks like and then building the pipelines and models to get there. 

What You Will Do 

  • Design and implement decoupled data supply chains, spanning landing zones, quality and transformation layers, and consumption layers, to ensure consistently high-quality data reaches analytics and AI systems 

  • Implement and document business KPIs as defined by business stakeholders, ensuring full metric traceability; define, implement, and document technical KPIs for AI application performance in collaboration with the data architect, ensuring explainability and observability across all AI-driven outputs 

  • Build and maintain a semantic layer that enables AI-based insight generation, bridging structured data assets with natural-language querying and large language model (LLM) integration 

  • Lead the expansion of existing BI reporting with AI-supported, RAG-driven analytics, progressively complementing manual report runs with dynamic, contextual insight delivery 

  • Develop and maintain data models, transformations, and pipelines using industry-standard tooling, complementing existing data infrastructure and ensuring data quality, lineage, and observability throughout 

  • Expose data assets and AI services via well-designed APIs, supporting consumption by both technical and non-technical consumers 

  • Act as a frontline coach and enabler for business users and citizen analysts, building AI and data literacy across the organisation and supporting adoption of AI-assisted workflows 

  • Embed security-by-design principles into all analytics and AI assets, including protections against prompt injection, data leakage, and model misuse 

  • Collaborate across IT, data, security, and business functions to ensure analytics outputs are governed, compliant with EU AI Act and GDPR requirements, and aligned to Intersnack's data sovereignty standards 


Essential Skills & Experience 

  • Proven experience designing and implementing multi-layer data architectures, including landing zones, transformation layers, and consumption layers

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one scripting or transformation language (e.g., Python, dbt) for data modelling and pipeline development

  • Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, vector stores, and RAG patterns, including the ability to build semantic layers and design LLM-integrated workflows using frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph

  • Experience with BI and analytics platforms (e.g., Qlik, Power BI, or equivalent) and a clear understanding of how to complement existing reporting with AI-assisted delivery

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and/or AWS data and AI services (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Azure ML, AWS Glue, SageMaker, or equivalent)

  • Demonstrated ability to engage with and understand non-technical business users, translating AI and data concepts into business language with clarity and confidence

  • Solid understanding of AI security fundamentals, including risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, and chain-reaction errors in AI pipelines

  • Awareness of relevant regulatory frameworks, including GDPR, the EU AI Act, and data sovereignty principles applicable in the EU context

  • A strong command of spoken and written English is required; knowledge of German is considered an advantage

Valuable Experience

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Purview, or OneLake for unified data governance and discovery, and with Microsoft Foundry for building and deploying LLM-integrated workflows and AI applications

  • Experience in FMCG, manufacturing, or procurement environments, with an understanding of the data and reporting challenges specific to these domains

  • Knowledge of Responsible AI principles and practical application of AI ethics frameworks

 

Important: Please note that a valid work and residence permit is required for non-EU applicants for this position.

Data tells stories, and this role is responsible for turning those stories into decisions. As our Data Scientist & ML Engineer, you will develop the predictive, prescriptive, and optimisation models that give Intersnack the analytical foresight to act confidently across procurement, manufacturing, and sales. You will report into the AI Programme and work alongside AI engineers and data engineers to integrate your models into the knowledge and agentic AI frameworks being built across the organisation, combining classical machine learning rigour with the emerging capabilities of large language models and intelligent agents. What We Can Offer

Dusseldorf is your home base, with flexibility for remote working, and Intersnack's international footprint ensures your models will operate at genuine scale.

jobs.title: Director of Go-to-Market Engineering
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.


About the Role

We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering.

Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it.

You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations, lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter.

This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace.

The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV.

What You'll Do

Own the strategy and the stack

  • Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.

  • Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.

  • Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.

  • Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.

Build, hands-on

  • Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.

  • Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.

  • Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.

  • Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.

Automate across SDR, AE, and AM

  • Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.

  • Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.

  • Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.

  • Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.

Bridge commercial and technical

  • Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.

  • Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.

  • Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.

Build the team

  • Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.

  • Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely.

  • Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure.

What Will Make You Successful

Experience

  • Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS

  • Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team

  • Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.

Technical craft

  • Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.

  • Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.

  • Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.

  • Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly.

Commercial instinct

  • You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.

  • You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer.

  • You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have

  • Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.

  • Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy.

  • Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America.

Why This Role

GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. This is the chance to own it properly, the stack, the architecture, the build, and the commercial outcome across a $300M+ revenue business with 800 people in the field, a genuine appetite for automation, and the budget and executive backing to move fast.

You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible.

If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.title: Panel Manager (f/m/d) - Freelancer / Contractor; 100% remote possible
jobs.description:
Panel Manager (f/m/d)

📍 Location: Remote (No Relocation)
💼 Employment Type: Contractor / Freelance ; 3 to 6 months contract

About PlaytestCloud

PlaytestCloud’s Player Insights Platform™ helps game studios improve their games through feedback from real players. Over 60% of the top-grossing game studios have tested their games with PlaytestCloud.

🏆 Premier provider for games. We help game studios worldwide make the best games they possibly can. 

🏆 Built for player insight. We build technology that enables secure, high-quality remote game testing. 

🏆 Independent and established. We are bootstrapped and profitable, with more than 400 paying game studios and over one million playtesters.

Our player community

PlaytestCloud runs one of the largest proprietary player panels in games: a large, growing, global community of players who take part because they care about making the games they play better. 

This isn't a role where you're building a panel from scratch. You'll be advising a mature Research Operations team that's already investing in the long-term health, quality, and strategic development of that community. 

Our goal is simple: help game studios make better decisions through real player insight. You'll play a central role in keeping that community trusted, representative, engaged, and ready for what game developers need next.

About the role

We're hiring an experienced, analytical Panel Manager (f/m/d) to shape the next stage of PlaytestCloud's proprietary player panel. Your job: figure out what makes a panel strong and scalable, then turn that understanding into measurable action. You'll identify the metrics that matter most, find opportunities to improve panel quality and availability, and build a practical framework that helps us serve studios better as we grow. This is a freelance contract (3–6 months) with a clear mission: build a stronger foundation for how we measure, manage, and grow our player panel.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Panel strategy and ownership. Take ownership of the health and growth of PlaytestCloud's global player panel.

  • Metrics and insight. Define and track the metrics that connect panel performance, player experience, studio needs, and business growth.

  • Opportunity identification. Analyze panel data to find the highest-impact opportunities, constraints, and risks.

  • Actionable improvements. Turn insight into practical recommendations, and work with the right teams to implement and measure them.

  • Cross-functional collaboration. Partner closely with Research Operations, Product, and GTM to make sure the panel supports great outcomes for our studios.

  • Sustainable foundations. Set up a reporting rhythm, performance framework, and roadmap the team can keep using after the contract ends.


Your profile

Must-have:

  • Panel experience. Recent hands-on experience managing, running, growing, or optimizing a large participant panel, research-participant community, or gaming community — including participant supply, retention, quality, segmentation, and/or incentive strategy. 

  • Commercial and analytical mindset. You know how to find the few metrics that actually matter, connect them to customer and business outcomes, and use data to make good calls. 

  • Tool competency. Comfortable querying databases in SQL, and familiar with agentic AI tools like Claude or Codex. 

  • Ownership. You're a self-starter who likes taking on an ambiguous challenge, building structure around it, and driving it forward on your own. 

  • Practical problem-solving. You turn analysis into clear priorities and action, not insight for its own sake. 

  • Strong communication. You can explain complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical people alike. 

  • Strong English. Comfortable communicating in written and spoken English on a remote, international team.

Great to have:

  • Qualitative research experience. Experience supporting or working closely with qualitative user research, including participant recruitment, study operations, interviews, usability testing, or research synthesis.

  • Games and player research. Interest in games, player research, or the gaming industry. Direct games-recruitment experience is not required.

Get in touch with us

Questions about the role or our hiring process? Email our Talent team at talent[at]playtestcloud.com.

Wie ben jij

Jij bent een verbindende projectleider met sterke organisatorische vaardigheden en gevoel voor bestuurlijke verhoudingen. Je behoudt overzicht in een dynamische omgeving, neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor resultaatgebieden en weet mensen mee te nemen in verandering. Voor deze rol zijn vooral de volgende competenties belangrijk:

Verbindend leiderschap, resultaatgerichtheid, organisatiesensitiviteit, analytisch vermogen en besluitvaardigheid. Je brengt structuur aan in complexe omgevingen, communiceert helder, creëert draagvlak en weet samenwerking tussen verschillende stakeholders effectief te organiseren.

Wat ga je doen

Als Projectleider binnen IT Kern bij Univé ben je verantwoordelijk voor het initiëren, coördineren en realiseren van organisatiebrede IT-projecten en verandertrajecten. Je opereert in een complexe omgeving waarin continuïteit, security, compliance, servicemanagement en digitale transformatie samenkomen.

Je werkt nauw samen met teammanagers, product owners, servicemanagers, architectuur, securityspecialisten, leveranciers en stakeholders binnen de Regionale Univé's.

Je zorgt ervoor dat projecten voorspelbaar, beheerst en met draagvlak worden uitgevoerd. Daarbij bewaak je de balans tussen run, change, innovatie en compliance.
Binnen IT Kern werk je aan trajecten die direct bijdragen aan de strategische beweging van Univé richting een moderne, omnichannel en toekomstbestendige IT-organisatie.

Wat ga je doen?
Als Projectleider IT Kern leid je complexe IT-projecten en verandertrajecten binnen een organisatiebrede context. Je zorgt voor een heldere projectaanpak, bewaakt voortgang, risico’s, afhankelijkheden, budget en kwaliteit, en stuurt multidisciplinaire teams aan. Je verbindt operationele IT-vraagstukken met strategische doelen en zorgt voor draagvlak bij management, CIO Office, Regionale Univé’s, leveranciers en interne IT-teams. Daarnaast begeleid je waar nodig RFI- en RFP-trajecten, van scopebepaling tot leveranciersselectie en overdracht naar implementatie.

Resultaatgebieden
De belangrijkste resultaatgebieden zijn:
Project- en teamsturing
Je stelt projectplannen op, organiseert projectteams en stuurt interne en externe betrokkenen aan op het behalen van het gewenste resultaat.
Governance en besluitvorming
Je zorgt voor duidelijke documentatie, rapportages en besluitvorming, onder andere richting stuurgroep en management.
Stakeholdermanagement
Je informeert, betrekt en verbindt stakeholders binnen IT, business, Regionale Univé’s en externe leveranciers.
Voortgang, kwaliteit en verbetering
Je bewaakt planning, capaciteit, risico’s en resultaten, evalueert projecten en draagt bij aan verbetering van projectmanagementaanpak en werkwijzen.

Algemene onderwerpen binnen de functie
Binnen de functie werk je aan thema’s die bijdragen aan een toekomstbestendige IT-organisatie, zoals IT-continuïteit, DORA en IT Assurance, security en autorisatiemanagement, cloudtransitie en sourcing. Ook spelen servicemanagement, governanceontwikkeling, waardestromen, roadmaps, OKR’s, kwartaalplanning en capaciteitsmanagement een belangrijke rol. Daarbij bewaak je steeds de balans tussen run, change, innovatie en compliance.

Wat bieden wij

Bij Univé IT bieden we je een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische organisatie. Je krijgt een rol waarin je zichtbaar bijdraagt aan de digitale transformatie van Univé en waarin je samenwerkt met gedreven professionals binnen IT Kern.

Deze functie is ingedeeld in schaal 10. De salarisrange ligt tussen € 64.830,24 en € 93.155,08 bruto per jaar op basis van een 38-urige werkweek. Dit is inclusief vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning.

  • een prima salaris, afhankelijk van je opleiding, ervaring en competenties;

Het team heeft een fijne werkplek in Zwolle, vlakbij het station. In overleg met het team behoort 2 tot 3 dagen thuiswerken tot de mogelijkheden.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dicht bij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. We richten ons op het voorkomen van risico's, het beperken van gevolgen en het verzekeren wanneer dat nodig is. Vanuit onze coöperatieve kracht ontwikkelen we samen continu nieuwe producten, diensten en oplossingen voor onze leden.

 

Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren naar een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platformorganisatie. Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé.

De IT-organisatie is ingericht met drie primaire afdelingen op de focusgebieden Kern, Data en Distributie. De CIO Office biedt ondersteuning door richting en houvast te geven aan strategische doelen en kaders.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Accounting (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Mach aus komplexer Buchhaltungssoftware eine, die Menschen ihre Arbeit leichter macht.

Bei Buena kaufen wir Hausverwaltungen und entwickeln die Software, mit der sie täglich arbeiten. Dadurch sind wir direkt an den Menschen, Prozessen und Problemen, für die wir bauen.

Buchhaltung ist ein zentraler Bestandteil dieser Arbeit. Ob Mietausschüttung, Unterkonten oder Jahresabrechnung: Abläufe müssen verständlich, Ergebnisse korrekt und Automatisierungen auch dann zuverlässig sein, wenn etwas vom Standardfall abweicht.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Buchhaltung tief versteht und dieses Wissen in bessere Software übersetzen kann. Gemeinsam mit unseren Nutzern, Engineering und Design findest du heraus, welche Probleme wir lösen müssen, wie eine gute Lösung aussieht und wohin sich unser Accounting-Produkt entwickeln soll.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Probleme wirklich verstehen: Du arbeitest dich in die Buchhaltungsprozesse unserer Hausverwaltungen ein – inklusive Sonderfällen, fachlichen Anforderungen und bestehender Einschränkungen.

  • Die richtigen Verbesserungen identifizieren: Du unterscheidest zwischen fehlenden Funktionen, unklaren Abläufen, technischen Fehlern und Fragen zur Bedienung.

  • Die Produktrichtung gestalten: Du entwickelst eine klare Vorstellung davon, wie Accounting bei Buena funktionieren soll, und priorisierst Verbesserungen nach Nutzen, fachlicher Notwendigkeit und Wirkung.

  • Lösungen konkret machen: Du übersetzt komplexe Anforderungen in verständliche Konzepte, Spezifikationen und Nutzerabläufe, die du mit Engineering und Design weiterentwickelst.

  • Korrektheit sicherstellen: Du prüfst Lösungen, denkst Sonderfälle durch und beurteilst, ob neue Funktionen die zugrunde liegenden Anforderungen erfüllen.

  • Bis zur Nutzung dranbleiben: Du begleitest Verbesserungen bis zur Einführung und überprüfst, ob sie das ursprüngliche Problem im Alltag lösen.

Das kann eine gezielte Verbesserung bei Mietausschüttungen sein – oder die grundlegende Weiterentwicklung unserer Kontenstruktur.

Was du mitbringst

  • Tiefes Buchhaltungsverständnis: Du kannst Abläufe erklären und erkennst, wenn etwas fachlich fehlt oder nicht stimmt. Erfahrung in der Immobilien- oder WEG-Buchhaltung ist besonders wertvoll.

  • Produktdenken: Du hinterfragst bestehende Arbeitsweisen, unterscheidest echte Anforderungen von Gewohnheiten und entwickelst Ideen für bessere Abläufe.

  • Analytische Stärke: Du zerlegst komplexe Probleme, vergleichst Lösungswege und erkennst, welcher nächste Schritt den größten Nutzen bringt.

  • Technische Neugier: Du möchtest verstehen, wie unsere Software funktioniert, und kannst Anforderungen und Abwägungen mit Engineers diskutieren.

  • Klare Kommunikation und Eigenverantwortung: Du bringst Fachlichkeit, Nutzerperspektive und Produktentwicklung zusammen und bleibst an einer Lösung, bis sie praktisch funktioniert.

Besonders relevant ist Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung oder Verbesserung von Buchhaltungssoftware. Dein bisheriger Jobtitel ist dabei zweitrangig: Entscheidend ist, dass du Buchhaltung verstehst und daraus sinnvolle Softwarelösungen ableiten kannst. Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools für Recherche, Prototypen oder Tests ist ein Plus.

Warum du bei Buena einsteigen solltest

  • Dein Fachwissen verändert das Produkt: Du arbeitest direkt mit den Menschen, die unsere Software nutzen, und siehst, was deine Entscheidungen im Alltag bewirken.

  • Du ergänzt ein starkes Team: Engineering und Design bringen ihre Expertise ein. Gemeinsam könnt ihr Probleme von der fachlichen Ursache bis zur fertigen Lösung bearbeiten.

  • Deine Ergebnisse schaffen Möglichkeiten: Wir wachsen schnell und geben Menschen Verantwortung, die etwas bewegen.

  • Du baust langfristig mit: Unsere Mission ist, Wohneigentum zugänglicher zu machen. Gute Software und funktionierende Hausverwaltungen bilden dafür die Grundlage.

Deine Benefits

  • Büronähe wird belohnt: Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus bei einem Wohnort mit 10–20 Minuten Fußweg zum Büro.

  • Verpflegung: 110 € monatliches Lunch-Budget.

  • Sport: 50 € Fitnesszuschuss.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

About the Role:
 
As an Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.
 
By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.
 
This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.
 
Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.
 
This is a hybrid role, in office 3 days a week in Paris.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Own NRR: Manage the full post-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.
  • Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.
  • Target Strategically: Prioritize high-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long-term growth plans.
  • Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
  • Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
  • Sell Competitively: Position Aircall’s value head-to-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer’s unique business needs.
  • Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
  • Manage Pipeline & Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data-driven NRR forecasting.
  • Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
  • Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall’s product roadmap and go-to-market strategies.
  • Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.

    • Qualifications:
  • Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets.
  • Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
  • Customer-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.
  • Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis.
  • Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively.
  • Analytical, detail-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene.
  • Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long-term value through partnership.
  • Excited by innovation and transformation — particularly the opportunity to represent a next-generation AI-powered communications platform.
    • Why Join our Account Management Team:
     
    At Aircall, you’ll join a fast-moving, customer-obsessed team that thrives at the intersection of success and growth. You’ll have the autonomy to build your book of business, the support of dedicated technical partners, and the opportunity to help customers unlock the full potential of Aircall’s communications and AI solutions.
     
    This is an exceptional opportunity for stellar sellers who want to deepen relationships with existing customers and drive measurable business impact — helping them realize the value of Aircall through trust, expertise, and long-term partnership.

    Why join us?

    🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities
    💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
    📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
    🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset
    💶 Competitive salary package & benefits

    DE&I Statement: 
    At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey. 

    We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We’re working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.  

    We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open. Above all else, we understand and acknowledge that we have work to do and much to learn.

jobs.title: Senior GNSS Software Architect / Principal GNSS Engineer
jobs.description:
Join our cutting-edge start-up adventure!

Who are we?

Join the Revolution in GNSS and IoT Connectivity

At Qualinx, we’re not just building chips, we’re engineering the future fabric of the connected world. As a pioneering semiconductor scale-up, we’re transforming how devices connect, communicate, and operate through our ground-breaking Digital RF technology. Our mission goes beyond ultra-low power GNSS: we’re redefining what’s possible in adaptive, scalable, and intelligent connectivity for the Internet of Things.

Born from deep-tech innovation at TU Delft, our team of visionary engineers and bold thinkers is tackling the toughest challenges in GNSS and IoT, starting with power consumption and expanding into dynamic, context-aware solutions that adapt to any environment or use case. We’ve already achieved what many thought impossible: the world’s most advanced GNSS chipset. But that’s just the beginning.

At Qualinx, we believe that the future of connectivity lies in precision, efficiency, and adaptability. Our ambition is to become the invisible thread that seamlessly interconnects billions of devices: powering a smarter, more responsive world.

What Sets Us Apart

Joining Qualinx is about becoming part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. We hold ourselves to high standards, thrive on solving the unexpected, and push boundaries together. But we also know how to enjoy the ride. Our culture is a unique blend of curiosity, team spirit, and a touch of unconventional charm. It’s fast-paced, fun, and grounded in a sober sense of purpose and perspective. Whether we’re deep in design reviews or sharing laughs over lunch, we’re building something meaningful together. At Qualinx, you’re not just contributing to a ground-breaking technology, you’re helping shape a team that’s redefining what it means to work in deep tech.

Job Description 

  • Define and own the end-to-end GNSS receiver software architecture, including acquisition, tracking, measurement engine, navigation, and positioning stack. 

  • Lead architectural decisions for low-power, high-performance GNSS chipsets, balancing performance, power, and silicon constraints. 

  • Translate product requirements into scalable, modular, and maintainable software architectures. 

  • Drive design trade-offs across algorithm complexity, hardware acceleration, and system constraints. 

  • Design and optimize advanced algorithms for: GNSS acquisition and tracking (multi-constellation, multi-frequency), Positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT), Multipath mitigation and interference suppression, Snapshot and ultra-low-power GNSS techniques 

  • Lead development of next-generation techniques such as: Assisted GNSS (A-GNSS), Hybrid positioning (GNSS + Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/IMU), LEO-PNT and emerging navigation paradigms 

  • Oversee implementation of GNSS algorithms in embedded C on RTOS / bare-metal systems, FPGA with focus on performance optimization, high-volume silicon deployment 

  • Mentor and guide engineers, contractors in GNSS algorithms and embedded development. Set technical direction and promote engineering best practices, design standards and lead technical reviews, architecture discussions, decision-making processes. 

  • Cross-Functional collaboration with product management to shape feature roadmap and differentiation strategy. Present technical concepts and results to internal and external stakeholders, including leadership teams and customers. 

Job requirements

Must haves 

Qualinx is looking for a result-driven and conscientious GNSS Engineer. Someone who thrives in an environment where your proactive and can-do attitude is highly appreciated. The ideal candidate for this role must have: 

  • Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, or related field. 

  • 10+ years of experience in GNSS, wireless communication systems, or signal processing. 

  • Proven track record in GNSS system design and product development. 

  • Deep understanding of the GNSS signal processing chain, including: 

  • Acquisition, tracking, measurements, and navigation 

  • Strong expertise in: 

  • Embedded C/C++ development on RTOS or bare-metal platforms 

  • MATLAB and Python for modelling and algorithm development 

  • Experience with full chip/product lifecycle, from concept to production. 

  • Strong understanding of low-power embedded system design and optimization. 

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and technical leadership skills. 

Nice to have 

  • Experience in GNSS software architecture ownership for commercial products. 

  • Knowledge of multi-constellation and multi-frequency GNSS systems (GPS, Galileo, BeiDou, GLONASS). 

  • Experience with RF front-end integration, calibration, and lab validation setups. 

  • Familiarity with FPGA prototyping and ASIC design flows. 

  • Knowledge of: 

  • SDR (Software Defined Radio) systems 

  • Wireless technologies (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, IoT positioning) 

  • Sensor fusion and hybrid positioning systems 

  • LEO-PNT, GNSS-R, or emerging navigation technologies 

  • High precision positioning 

  • Demonstrated experience in leading teams or mentoring engineers. 


What's in it for you?

At Qualinx, we believe that great work starts with a great environment, pioneering technology and a fun dynamic market to address. Here’s what you can expect when you join our team:

  • Ownership and Impact: We offer employee equity, giving you the opportunity to share in the success you help create.

  • Well-being Matters: Your physical and mental health are important to us. We provide access to wellness resources, including company discounts and a free mental healthcare platform.

  • Global Talent, Local Support: If you're relocating from abroad, we provide full support throughout the visa process to ensure a smooth transition.

  • Future-Focused Benefits: We contribute to your pension savings to help you plan ahead with confidence.

  • Inspiring Workspace: Work from a modern and vibrant, well-equipped office designed to help you do your best work.

  • Scale-up Team Spirit: We celebrate our wins together with fun quarterly events—think great food, games, and unforgettable experiences.

jobs.title: Application Engineer | Semiconductor Test Solutions
jobs.description:
Do you want to work in a high tech environment where innovation is not a promise, but daily practice? At Salland Engineering, you work on technology for testing the chips of tomorrow. You will have access to state of the art tooling, modern test facilities and an environment where your own ideas, creativity and initiative are valued.

Salland Engineering is growing fast. This year, we are doubling our effective workspace, further expanding our testers and investing heavily in new technologies, including innovation in the field of photonics. As part of a global player in the semiconductor test market, we combine international strength with the freedom and short lines of communication of Salland in Zwolle.

As an Application Engineer, you play an important role in developing turnkey test solutions for testing chips on ATE, or Automated Test Equipment. Together with the customer, you define the test strategy and translate chip and customer requirements into a smart, reliable and best fit test solution.

In this role, you work closely with chip designers and product engineers from the world’s largest electronics manufacturers. From the first concept to validation and release to production, you make a direct contribution to test solutions that truly make a difference. Within Salland, you work closely with colleagues in the department and with the PCB design team. You are part of an engineering team where sharing knowledge, making smart choices together and building quality are central. Most of your work will be based at our headquarters in Zwolle, with occasional assignments at customer sites.

What you will be doing in your role

  • Set up and validate test strategies and methodologies and document this in an Electrical Test Specification (ETS);

  • Together with a PCB engineer, create hardware schematics for the interface between the ATE and the chip;

  • Develop turnkey, chip-specific test solutions to run on the ATE for testing ICs in production;

  • When requested, characterize the chip according to specifications and report the results;

  • Validate the whole test solution and report the results (GR&R);

  • Maintain close contact with the customer to discuss interim and final results;

  • Responsible for planning and report project progress to the Project Manager;

  • Support colleagues within the engineering team.

Where will you work

Nice to meet you, we are Salland Engineering from Zwolle.

For more than 30 years, we have been developing solutions and services for testing chips. Our technology can be found in everyday products such as smartphones, tablets and cars. Together with around 95 colleagues, we work on innovative projects every day and serve the world’s largest manufacturers of chips and measuring instruments.

What will you get from us

A challenging job in a high-tech environment. We value taking initiative and taking responsibility, but there is more.

We offer:

  • An attractive salary, depending on your education and experience, between € 3.410,57 and € 4.872,23 gross per month (job scale: Engineer Expert A) based on a 40-hour workweek.

  • An environment where development is central. For us, it is essential to remain an interesting player in the market. That is why, as an employee at Salland Engineering, you are given all the space, opportunities and freedom to develop yourself, so that we can continue to grow together.
