jobs.title: Data Engineer - AI Pipelines & DataOps
jobs.description:
We Want You to Grow With Us

High-quality, reliable data is the foundation on which every AI use case is built, and this role is responsible for making that foundation unshakeable. As our Data Engineer for AI Pipelines & DataOps, you will design and deliver the ingestion pipelines, streaming architectures, and APIs that feed Intersnack's AI and analytics systems with the data they need to perform at scale. You will report into the AI Programme and work in close collaboration with AI engineers, data architects, and business teams, with a particular focus on manufacturing environments, where edge device data presents unique ingestion challenges. At Intersnack, we build on a solid digital foundation, and your engineering work will be central to extending that foundation into the AI era.

What We Can Offer

This role offers the opportunity to work across a genuinely diverse data landscape, from manufacturing edge devices and IoT sensors to structured enterprise data systems across procurement and sales, giving you breadth of technical challenge that few data engineering roles can match. You will have direct influence over how AI and analytics use cases are enabled across a 4.5bn euro business, with the autonomy to define pipeline patterns, API standards, and DataOps practices that others will build on. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and you will be embedded in a programme team that spans data science, AI architecture, and business enablement. Dusseldorf is the home base, with flexibility for remote working.

How You Will Spend Your Time as Our Next Data Engineer - AI Pipelines & DataOps

You will design and build the data infrastructure that powers Intersnack's AI programme, from scalable ingestion pipelines that handle both structured enterprise data and unstructured signals from manufacturing environments, to the APIs that expose data, models, and AI services for consumption across the organisation. Your work will span architecture, implementation, and operations, with a strong focus on quality, observability, and continuous improvement.

What You Will Do

  • Design and implement scalable data ingestion pipelines for structured and unstructured data sources, including manufacturing systems, edge devices, and enterprise data platforms, ensuring consistent data quality from source to consumption

  • Build and maintain both batch and streaming data pipelines for analytics and AI use cases, leveraging cloud-native tooling on Microsoft Azure and/or AWS

  • Design and expose REST or GraphQL APIs for data assets, machine learning model endpoints, and AI services, enabling reliable, governed consumption by internal applications and analytical systems

  • Implement CI/CD practices and DataOps principles across pipeline development and deployment, supporting automated testing, versioning, and release management for data infrastructure

  • Ensure data quality, lineage, and observability across all pipelines, implementing monitoring and alerting that surfaces data issues before they affect AI or analytics outputs

  • Support the integration of manufacturing and edge device data, including IoT and OT systems, into the central data platform, addressing the specific latency, format, and volume challenges of operational technology environments

  • Collaborate with data scientists and AI engineers to design and optimise data flows that support model training, inference, and knowledge retrieval pipelines

  • Apply security-by-design practices to all pipeline and API design, including access control, encryption, and protections against data leakage, in line with Intersnack's sovereignty and compliance standards

  • Contribute to the AI literacy and enablement programme by supporting colleagues in understanding data pipeline health, data quality standards, and the role of reliable data in AI outcomes


Essential Skills & Experience 

  • Proven experience designing and implementing production-grade data pipelines using cloud-native services on Microsoft Azure (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Azure Event Hubs, Databricks) and/or AWS (e.g., AWS Glue, Kinesis, Lake Formation)

  • Strong proficiency in at least one pipeline or transformation framework (e.g., Apache Spark, dbt, Apache Kafka, or equivalent) and a scripting language such as Python or Scala

  • Solid hands-on experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB, MongoDB, or equivalent), including data modelling and query optimisation for both transactional and analytical workloads

  • Experience building and maintaining streaming and batch pipelines for analytics and AI applications, with an understanding of trade-offs between the two approaches

  • Ability to design and implement REST or GraphQL APIs for data and model serving, with an understanding of API versioning, documentation, and governance

  • Familiarity with DataOps and CI/CD practices as applied to data engineering, including automated testing, pipeline orchestration, and infrastructure-as-code

  • Experience with data quality tooling, lineage tracking, and observability frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, OpenLineage, or equivalent)

  • Working knowledge of AI and data security fundamentals, including data access controls, encryption, and risks such as data exfiltration in pipeline contexts

  • Awareness of GDPR, EU AI Act, and EU data sovereignty requirements and their implications for data infrastructure design

  • A strong command of spoken and written English is required; knowledge of German is considered an advantage

Valuable Experience

  • Experience working with manufacturing or operational technology (OT) data environments, including IoT/edge device data ingestion and time-series data handling

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, or Azure Purview for unified data platform management

  • Exposure to MLOps practices, including data versioning, feature stores, or model monitoring pipelines

  • Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tooling for scalable, repeatable data infrastructure deployment

  • Background in FMCG, manufacturing, or supply chain, providing context for the operational data challenges typical in these environments

Intersnack IT KG is a member of the Pfeifer & Langen Industrie- und Handels-KG’s group of companies and a sister company to Intersnack Group. Established from the international harmonization and centralization of Intersnack Group’s IT estate, we are responsible for all group-wide IT services for and within Intersnack Group. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agents (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
About this role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Agentic SOC team. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. This team's mission is to build LLM-powered agents that augment our security analysts, taking on repetitive investigation and triage work so humans can focus on the judgment-heavy parts of the job.

You will work in a small, full-stack team of 2 to 3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets, and who is excited about shipping agents into a real production SOC where correctness, latency, and cost all matter.

In this role

  • Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production. You are trusted to take a high-level goal and turn it into a plan without close supervision.

  • Lead the design and delivery of LLM agents that plug into our SOC workflows, including tool design, prompt and context engineering, evals, and guardrails. Make sound tradeoffs on accuracy, cost, latency, and how much autonomy to give the agent versus keeping a human in the loop.

  • Drive technical design discussions in your stream and, where the work calls for it, influence architecture and standards beyond it. Set the bar for code quality, testing, and documentation on your team.

  • Ground engineering decisions in outcomes. Push back when the "why" is unclear, propose simpler or faster paths to the business result, and stay close to the security analysts and customers your agents are meant to serve.

  • Mentor engineers on your team and across the stream through pairing, code review, and design feedback. Act as a multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor.

  • Participate in hiring: interview candidates, help shape the bar, and support onboarding.

  • Contribute to a psychologically safe and outcome-oriented team culture. Lead by example in incidents and high-pressure moments.

  • The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, with a commitment to travel to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week.

What you will need

  • 5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently.

  • Depth in at least one technical area and broad competence across the stack. You have designed and shipped systems where performance, security, reliability, and maintainability all mattered, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made.

  • Experience with strongly typed languages (Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP, or similar). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our stack quickly.

  • Hands-on experience building LLM agents, with evidence they were useful. You have built and shipped at least one non-trivial LLM-powered agent or agentic workflow, in production or as a side project with real users. You can speak concretely about the design choices you made around tool use, context and state, evals, failure handling, autonomy, cost, and latency and, just as importantly, what the agent changed for the people using it.

  • Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow.

  • A track record of raising the level of engineers around you through mentoring, code review, and design feedback.

  • Strong communication skills. You can translate technical tradeoffs for engineers, product managers, and leadership, and you write designs and decisions in a way others can build on.

  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and secure development principles to build safe, trusted systems.

  • Fluency in English is a must.

What we offer

  • Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe.

  • Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact.

  • A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering and AI-augmented security operations: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice for both how we build and how our SOC operates.

  • Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure.

  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.

  • Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe.

  • We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together.

About Eye Security

 

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

 

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

 

We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply!

Joining Weezevent means working on tangible solutions used at international festivals (Hellfest, Boomtown, Tomorrowland, Lollapalooza, Boom), major sporting events (Formula 1, the Olympic Games, Euro fan zones), and high-volume live experiences.

Weezevent builds the technology behind live events: ticketing, cashless payment, CRM, staff solutions and access control. We are about 100 people in the tech team (engineering and product organisation), part of a group that has grown both organically and through acquisitions, so our teams span several countries and cultures.

We are at an inflection point. We are opening a focused 12–18 month window to invest heavily in the foundations of our main product, WeezTicket: paying down technical debt, tightening our architecture, and setting ourselves up for the next phase of growth. To run that program, we’re hiring an Engineering Delivery & Operations Manager (M/F, based in Clichy) to own its delivery.

Vos missions

This is a two-part role, and the first part is where you’ll spend most of your first year.

Part one : deliver the program. A board of our most experienced engineers is defining the architectural direction and producing a large backlog of clean-up and improvement work. That work will be delivered by several external squads brought in for the program. You own the delivery layer between them: getting squads stood up and productive on time, tracking each one’s pace and quality, and keeping the whole program on schedule.

  • Stand up and onboard external squads, around 20 developers across 5 to 6 squads, on time : access, environments, documentation, and a well-scoped first backlog ready before they start
  • Track the delivery pace of each squad against its commitments, and keep a clear program-level view of what’s on track, slipping, or blocked
  • Hold squads to the quality bar set by the architectural board : tests, reviews, and no new debt introduced while removing old debt
  • Manage cross-squad dependencies so work lands in the right order
  • Track program spend against budget and manage the relationships with the partners supplying the squads
  • Report program status to the CTO and the board on a regular cadence

Part two : become the operational backbone of engineering. As the program matures, you’ll take on the people-operations side of the organisation: helping our managers run great 1:1s and reviews, coordinating the performance cycle, keeping an eye on team capacity and wellbeing, and bringing rigour to tooling and budget. This is what makes the role a long-term home rather than a temporary program job.

You’ll work closely with the CTO, the architectural board, our 4 Team Leads, and the external partners supplying the squads. You won’t set the technical strategy or write the code, you’ll make sure the right work gets delivered, on time, at the right quality.

  • Help 4 Team Leads and 6 Squad Leads run consistent 1:1s and grow as managers
  • Coordinate the performance review cycle and make sure follow-up actions actually happen
  • Keep visibility on team capacity, absences, and early signals of overload or burnout
  • Bring structure to tech budget tracking and to the governance of our tools and licences
  • Support hiring and internal mobility alongside our recruitment team

Vos compétences

Must-haves

  • Experience running a multi-squad delivery program end to end: ideally involving external agencies, consultancies, or contract teams
  • A track record of onboarding external teams onto an existing codebase and getting them productive quickly
  • Comfort owning a backlog, a schedule, and a budget across several parallel workstreams at once
  • The ability to track pace and quality per team and raise problems early, with data
  • Genuine tech literacy: you understand what developers do, can navigate a Jira board, and know what technical debt actually means
  • Fluent French and English

What makes you a strong long-term fit

  • Some experience coaching or supporting managers, or running a performance cycle in a tech company
  • A background that touched engineering, delivery, project management, or product before moving toward operations
  • Analytical rigour: you’re comfortable with numbers, dashboards, and cost reports
  • Direct, honest communication and real discretion with sensitive information

Nice to have

  • A third language (German or Dutch is a real plus given our footprint)
  • Experience working across France, the UK, the Netherlands, or Germany, and an understanding of how management styles differ across them

This is not

  • A role that sets architecture or writes code; that’s the board and the squads
  • A pure recruiter or a corporate-HR profile with no delivery or engineering exposure
  • A process-for-process’s-sake job. We want impact, not bureaucracy

The recruitment process

  • HR interview - background and soft skills
  • Interview with CTO - technical discussion

All our positions are open to people with disabilities.

Why it's a good move

You’ll run a high-visibility program with the direct backing of the CTO and the most senior engineers in the company, in an organisation that has decided to genuinely invest in its technical foundations rather than just talk about it. And when the program lands, you’ll have built yourself a permanent, central role at the heart of how our engineering organisation runs.

jobs.title: GM, Sales (EMEA)
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Opportunity

Deepgram is expanding into EMEA, and we're seeking a GM, Sales to own the region — building and leading the Enterprise and commercial segments of our Account Executive team, establishing Deepgram's European home in London, and driving growth across the region.

This role is both strategic and hands-on. You'll work with sales leadership to continue optimizing the systems, playbooks, and culture that scale ARR growth, while developing a high-performing team that converts opportunities into long-lasting customers. A core part of your mission is building Deepgram's next generation of sales talent through world-class training, coaching, and structured career development.

You'll also be more than a revenue leader. As our senior-most voice in EMEA, you'll bring what you learn in the field back into the company and shape what we build — regional product-market fit, roadmap priorities, and the technical requirements European enterprises hold us to.

You'll partner closely with Marketing, Sales Leadership, RevOps, Customer Success, and Product to align pipeline strategy and leverage modern AI tools to boost productivity, personalization, and team efficiency. Equal parts operator, coach, and builder, you'll combine data-driven rigor with creativity to shape how Deepgram grows its customer base and its sales talent.

What You'll Do

  • Scale the Region: Own the EMEA number. Build and execute a strategic roadmap to drive hyper-growth in ARR, from initial land to enterprise-wide expansion.

  • Open London: Stand up Deepgram's London office as our EMEA hub — and treat it as a commercial asset, not just real estate. It will host customer and developer events, executive briefings, partner sessions, and the team you build.

  • "Challenge & Lead": Recruit and mentor a high-performance team of Account Executives. Manage Customer Success, Marketing, and Forward Deployed Engineers in a dotted-line structure. You will instill a culture of "Challenger" selling — teaching AEs how to disrupt legacy incumbents and lead with technical ROI.

  • Shape the Product: Act as the voice of EMEA inside Deepgram. Translate field signal — deal losses, evaluation criteria, data residency and compliance requirements, language and accent coverage — into specific, prioritized input that changes what we build and when.

  • Build the Ecosystem: Identify and sign strategic regional partners, GSIs, and local resellers to act as a force multiplier for Deepgram's direct sales efforts.

  • Operational Excellence: Implement rigorous forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and territory management across multiple countries, languages, and buying cultures. You will bridge the gap between London and our US HQ.

  • C-Suite Influence: Act as the primary executive sponsor for major regional accounts, navigating complex procurement cycles and technical AI evaluations.

You'll Love This Role If You

  • Thrive on building and scaling high-performing teams that consistently beat targets.

  • Want to build something from the ground up — including the office, the team, and the regional playbook.

  • Value working with tenured, high-caliber leaders who prioritize clarity, accountability, collaboration, and execution.

  • Enjoy blending data-driven sales operations with creative, human-centered leadership.

  • Are energized by developing AEs and building a culture of growth and continuous learning.

  • Believe in the power of AI to transform productivity, and are eager to harness cutting-edge tools to optimize performance.

  • Are passionate about Deepgram's mission to redefine what's possible with speech technology.

It's Important to Us That You Have

  • Experience: 12+ years in B2B SaaS sales, with 5+ years in a senior leadership role (Director/VP) covering EMEA — including the UK and at least one of DACH, the Nordics, France, or Southern Europe.

  • The "Deepgram DNA": A deep fascination with AI, LLMs, and API-first products. You should be comfortable discussing technical architecture as easily as you discuss revenue targets.

  • Product Influence: You've done more than sell — you've changed what your company built. You can point to specific roadmap decisions, features, or product bets that happened because of how you brought the market back to Product and Engineering.

  • Proven Growth: A track record of scaling a regional business from early traction to high-scale maturity ($10M+ ARR growth experience preferred).

  • Partnership Prowess: Demonstrable experience building channel programs that significantly contribute to the total revenue mix.

  • High ASP Focus: Expertise in value-based selling to increase Average Selling Price and win rates in a competitive technical landscape.

  • Operational Rigor: Deep familiarity with modern sales stacks (Salesforce, Gong, Clari, etc.) and a commitment to data-driven decision-making.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree required; MBA or technical degree is a plus.

It Would Be Great If You Had

  • Experience opening a new office or first in-region presence for a US-headquartered company.

  • Experience leading AE organizations at a high-growth, Series B+ startup or scaling tech company.

  • Background selling developer tools, infrastructure, or AI/ML technologies.

  • Fluency in navigating EU data protection and AI regulation as a commercial topic, not just a legal one.

  • Expertise in building talent development programs or performance coaching frameworks.

  • Comfort operating in dynamic, fast-moving environments with evolving goals and systems.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will establish a shared, evidence-based view of our customers through clear personas, journey maps, research practices and a structured insight repository. • Translate customer needs into product solutions by creating product/service blueprints, journey maps, experience maps, prototypes, and workflow diagrams, and by collaborating with Product and R&D on hardware and software recommendations.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Search & AI
Associate II, Product Operations
jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Krak is Kraken's consumer banking and payments product — a fast-moving team building the card, payments, and financial features that bring crypto to everyday life. The Krak Product Operations team sits at the heart of this, making sure the business can move quickly without getting blindsided by compliance, risk, vendor, or operational dependencies.

This is one of two roles in Krak’s Product Ops function, reporting to the Manager, Product Ops - Krak. You'll bring leadership to the day-to-day, working directly with compliance, legal, fraud, client engagement (CE), and external vendors to make sure new features land safely and successfully.

 

The opportunity

Product Ops at Krak is a co-ordination and intelligence function. Your job is to make sure that the cross-functional dependencies that could slow or derail delivery are surfaced early, actively managed, and resolved. You'll also help the team make better product decisions by curating the right operational data and bringing market and vendor intelligence into the room.

You'll work across four areas: compliance and risk co-ordination, third party vendor management, responding to management information (MI) and feature performance, and strategic market intelligence. Your job is to make sure the right conversations happen at the right time, and that nothing falls through the cracks on the way to launch.

 

Compliance & risk co-ordination

  • Maintain live, product-specific trackers of open compliance and legal items, including DRIs, status, and upcoming milestones

  • Triage new features against regulatory requirements ahead of development; ensure sign-off is built into delivery milestones

  • Work closely with fraud leads to ensure fraud controls and risk/velocity rules are factored into feature design (card, third party payments, and others)

  • Ensure fraud and CE teams are operationally positioned - with the right tooling, admin access, battlecards, and support articles - ahead of new product and feature launches

  • Support incident response for product-related issues and ensure post-incident reviews feed into product changes

     

Third party vendor management

  • Maintain product-specific vendor trackers covering status, open actions, key contacts, and upcoming milestones

  • Own the cadence for performance reviews with key vendors and track actions to closure

  • Maintain a working view of vendor roadmaps and capabilities; produce periodic briefings on where vendor developments create product opportunities or constraints

 

Responding to MI & feature performance

  • Ensure experiments and feature launches are supported by readily available fraud, dispute, and CE metrics alongside commercial KPIs

  • Interpret fraud, dispute, CE, and auth/decline data to identify emerging issues and surface them to the right teams

  • Drive follow-through on cross-functional findings - whether that's a compliance flag or a vendor issue

 

Strategic market intelligence

  • Scan the market for competitors' changes to features, pricing, and risk positioning

  • Monitor regulatory and market developments that could affect the Krak roadmap

  • Identify third party vendor capabilities that could enable features not yet on the roadmap; flag where the current stack may be a constraint

 

What you bring

  • 3-5 years experience in a product operations, strategy, or programme management role in a consumer fintech, payments, or banking business - ideally at a company with a card or payments product

  • Strong working knowledge of the regulatory and compliance landscape for consumer financial products in one of more regions

  • Experience working alongside or within fraud and risk functions; understanding of how fraud controls interact with product design

  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams with different stakeholders and different cadences, without dropping the ball

  • Track record of turning complex operational data into clear, actionable MI for product and leadership teams

  • Structured thinker who's comfortable in the detail but can step back and see the bigger picture

  • Strong communicator - able to translate between the worlds of compliance, risk, engineering, and product

 

Nice to haves

  • Experience with card issuing programmes (scheme rules, chargeback processes, fraud typologies)

  • Familiarity with third party banking and payments vendors (e.g. BIN sponsors, scheme processors, TPP aggregators)

  • Prior experience in a fast-scaling consumer fintech or neobank

  • Exposure to crypto or digital assets products

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren software engineer of architect die inhoudelijk sterk wil blijven, maar ook graag een team verder brengt?

Bij adesso Nederland zoeken we een Lead Software Engineering. Iemand die technologie, mensen en delivery bij elkaar brengt. Je bent niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van je team, maar blijft zelf dicht bij de inhoud en onze klanten.

Je werkt met ervaren software engineers aan uitdagende klantomgevingen en helpt tegelijkertijd onze Software Engineering-practice verder uit te bouwen. Van Java en moderne frontendtechnologie tot cloud, architectuur en agentic software engineering.

Geen rol waarin je alleen maar gaat managen dus. Je blijft onderdeel van het vak.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Lead Software Engineering geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 5 tot 12 consultants en developers. Je coacht collega's, helpt ze groeien en zorgt ervoor dat zij op projecten zitten die passen bij hun kennis, ervaring en ontwikkeling.

Tegelijkertijd ben je betrokken bij onze klanten en projecten. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van delivery, denkt mee over architectuur en engineeringvraagstukken en springt bij wanneer een project inhoudelijk of organisatorisch extra aandacht nodig heeft.

Je rol bestaat grofweg uit vier onderdelen:

People & team
Je voert 1-op-1's, begeleidt ontwikkeling en performance en helpt collega's bij hun volgende stap. Je zorgt voor een goede onboarding van nieuwe collega's en bent actief betrokken bij recruitment en selectie.

Software Engineering & delivery
Je blijft inhoudelijk betrokken bij software engineering en kunt zelf een leidende rol pakken op een technisch of architectuurvraagstuk. Je bewaakt kwaliteit, planning en risico's en zorgt dat onze teams voorspelbaar en professioneel leveren.

Tegelijkertijd help je engineers zich ontwikkelen richting Agentic Engineering: minder tijd besteden aan het produceren van code en meer aan het definiëren van context, architectuur en kwaliteit, het orkestreren van agents en het reviewen en valideren van de output.

Klanten & commercie
Je ziet wat er bij klanten speelt en vertaalt dat naar kansen voor adesso. Je denkt mee in presales, voorstellen en bids en helpt oplossingen vorm te geven die technisch én commercieel kloppen. Bij bestaande klanten herken je mogelijkheden voor vervolgprojecten en uitbreiding.

Daarbij verschuift de focus steeds meer van het leveren van capaciteit naar het realiseren van engineering outcomes: sneller bouwen, moderniseren en klanten helpen hun engineeringorganisatie toekomstbestendig te maken.

Groei van onze Software Engineering-practice
Je helpt bepalen welke kennis, technologie en capabilities we als team nodig hebben. Je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen onder andere Java, frontend, cloud, architectuur en Agentic Engineering en vertaalt die naar onze manier van werken.

Je helpt daarmee niet alleen individuele engineers groeien, maar bouwt mee aan een schaalbare engineering capability binnen adesso.


We zoeken geen klassieke people manager die de techniek inmiddels heeft losgelaten. We zoeken juist iemand die software engineering begrijpt én mensen kan meenemen in de ontwikkeling van het vak.

Je hebt ruime ervaring binnen software engineering en hebt bijvoorbeeld gewerkt als Senior Software Engineer, Tech Lead, Lead Developer of Software Architect. Je hebt ervaring met Java en/of moderne software-architecturen en begrijpt wat nodig is om complexe softwareprojecten succesvol te leveren.

Daarnaast:

  • heb je circa 7–8 jaar of meer relevante ervaring binnen softwareontwikkeling en complexe projecten;

  • heb je ervaring met het begeleiden, coachen of aansturen van andere engineers;

  • kun je met zowel developers als klanten en management schakelen;

  • begrijp je onderwerpen als delivery, capaciteit, kwaliteit en projectmarge;

  • heb je ervaring binnen consultancy of projectmatige dienstverlening, of voel je je thuis in zo'n omgeving;

  • vind je het interessant om mee te bouwen aan proposities, presales en klantrelaties;

  • volg je ontwikkelingen rondom AI, AI-agents en Agentic Engineering;

  • beheers je de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed.

Certificeringen op het gebied van Java, cloud, architectuur of software engineering zijn mooi meegenomen, maar voor ons zijn je ervaring en wat je daadwerkelijk hebt gebouwd en geleid belangrijker.

At Eco Counter (Traffic Technology), we help cities, transport authorities and public organisations understand and improve mobility through innovative counting and data solutions.

To support our growth in the UK, we are looking for a true New Business Sales Hunter who thrives on opening doors, building relationships with decision-makers and winning new clients.

This is a pure new business role focused on identifying opportunities, creating a pipeline and converting prospects into long-term partnerships : Your key role will be to identify opportunities, engage decision-makers and position Eco Counter as the preferred partner for mobility data solutions :

Key Responsibilities

  • Working with the General Manager to develop and deliver New Business Development strategies which identify and target new business opportunities within the Active Travel and Transport market and exposes the Eco-Counter organisation to prospective new clients

  • Drive new business development through proactive outreach methodology, professional presentation with swift responses to created opportunities

  • Win new business by developing a strong understanding of client needs, identifying and recommending the most suitable Eco-Counter solutions which exceed client requirements and deliver long term recurring revenue.

  • Engage with and meet decision-makers in cities, counties, national parks, and other public bodies – building long term relationships and becoming their trusted solution expert to ensure Eco Counter solutions are always their preferred choice

  • Attend industry events, conferences to develop market knowledge, competitor activity and network decision makers to monitor and report on industry regulations, government incentives, and new technologies.

  • Participate in industry events, trade shows, and conferences to gather market intelligence and support brand presence.


What We’re Looking For

  • A real sales “Hunter” with a passion for delivering new sales and driving exceptional customer experience

  • Someone who “Loves the thrill of the chase” with excellent ability to explain technical concepts in a clear and accessible way

  • Someone who will go the “extra mile” with an “ABC” mindset and sales approach with a demonstrable track record in successful NBD sales roles

  • 5-10 years experience of working in the Public sector with a strong interest in active transportation, sustainability, or public space planning and established contacts in the urban or nature sectors would be a real positive

  • If you have the above Sales Skill set and experience of the Active Travel, Transport and Road Safety sectors and how these impact a Greener, Safer and Heathier environment you could be an ideal candidate

  • Willingness to travel across UK with occasional international visits

About You

You are someone who:

  • Enjoys prospecting and opening new doors

  • Is motivated by building a pipeline from scratch

  • Thrives in a target-driven environment

  • Is curious, persistent and relationship-oriented

  • Can engage confidently with senior public sector stakeholders

  • Is comfortable working independently while collaborating with internal teams

  • Has a strong communicator with excellent interpersonal and presentation skills

  • Comfortable using CRM and Sales performance tools to accurately report on activity, build and deliver from a pipeline

 

What We Offer

·       The opportunity to join an innovative international company with a meaningful global mission with demonstrable growth & profitability

·       A supportive and collaborative work environment with an open people and trusting culture

·       Opportunities for professional development and travel

·       Competitive salary and benefits (to be discussed based on ability and experience)

jobs.title: Cyber Security Consultant - Dionach by Nomios
jobs.description:
Location                      

This role offers flexibility to work remotely, with regular visits to client sites. Alternatively, you can choose a hybrid arrangement and work from our offices in Oxford or Glasgow, if preferred and UK based.

Why join Dionach by Nomios?

Since being acquired by Nomios in late 2024, Dionach by Nomios has continued its dynamic growth as a leading information security company. Specializing in penetration testing and information assurance services, we offer an incredible opportunity to be part of an experienced team, build your skills, and grow professionally.

Dionach by Nomios holds impressive certifications, including CREST, CHECK, PCI QSA, and ISO 27001. With our focus on enhancing customers' security and fostering team development, you'll be joining a company that prioritizes both your growth and the safety of our clients.

Dionach is also proud to be Great Place To Work® Certified™ and recognised as one of the UK’s Best Workplaces in Tech™ 2026. This achievement is based entirely on feedback from our team and reflects our commitment to creating an environment where people feel supported, valued and able to grow. Learn more about our certification here: Working at Dionach | Great Place to Work® UK.

We're in an exciting phase of expansion and are looking for self-motivated individuals ready to thrive in a fun, flexible environment. At Dionach by Nomios, your contributions will have a genuine impact on the business, and you'll find opportunities for both interesting work and career development.

Benefits

Our employees are the heart of our business. We value our employees and invest in their growth and well-being. Here's what we offer:

  • Hybrid Working: Flexibility to work remotely or use our UK offices around client visits.

  • Professional Growth: Access to training labs, certification sponsorship, and time for skill development.

  • Well-being Focus: Private health insurance, eye care plan, income protection, EAP scheme, and well-being platform.

Contractors will not have these benefits.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Dionach by Nomios, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We're dedicated to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. We welcome applications from all backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, and we're committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, age, disability, or any other legally protected status.

We encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply and are committed to providing a supportive and accessible environment for all our employees. If you require accommodations during the application process, let us know, and we'll work to meet your needs.

Screening Requirements

This role requires successful completion of the Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) screening prior to commencement. BPSS is a government-mandated pre-employment check that includes identity verification, right to work, employment history, and criminal record screening.

Depending on the nature of the work undertaken, additional security clearance at Security Check (SC) level or above may also be required. Candidates must be eligible to work in the UK and willing to undergo the necessary vetting processes.

Please note that Dionach does not hold a sponsor licence and is therefore unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have and maintain the right to work in the UK without sponsorship throughout employment with Dionach.


What You'll Do

  • Conduct penetration tests across various environments, including web applications, APIs, Cloud, and network infrastructure.

  • Issue detailed reports outlining findings, risks, and recommendations for remediation.

  • Translate complex technical findings into actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Stay updated with the latest security trends, tools, and techniques.

  • Participate in research and development projects.

  • Focus on your development by attaining industry recognised certifications.

  • Be available for occasional on-call duties and on-site client engagements, as needed.

What We're Looking For

  • Certifications: Relevant certifications such as CREST CRT, CREST CCT, OSCP, OSWE, OSCE, or equivalent level.

  • Experience: At least two years in penetration testing, covering network, web, and internal tests and customer engagements.

  • Tools: Proficiency with tools like Burpsuite Pro, Nessus, and other industry standards.

  • Communication: Strong verbal and written skills for stakeholder management, collaboration and report writing.

  • Independence: Ability to work solo or as part of a team on penetration tests.

  • Eligibility: Right to work in the UK and eligibility for security clearance.

Key Attributes

  • Analytical thinker with a proactive, detail-oriented approach.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of engaging with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and adapt to rapidly changing threat landscapes.

  • Commitment to maintaining the highest ethical and professional standards.

Are you an experienced penetration tester looking to further improve your skills and take on more responsibilities? If so, this opportunity is perfect for you! We look forward to receiving your applications!

jobs.title: Architecte Logiciel et Système d'Information
jobs.description:
Nous recherchons un(e) Architecte Logiciel et Système d'Information pour rejoindre nos équipes à Toulouse.
Vous contribuerez à définir et faire évoluer l’architecture de notre système d’information et de nos produits digitaux : plateforme immobilière, application mobile, sites Internet, APIs, services et outils internes.
Vous ferez le lien entre vision d'architecture et réalité du terrain. Vous contribuerez aux décisions structurantes du SI tout en restant proche des développeurs et des problématiques concrètes de conception, de réalisation et d'exploitation.

Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec les développeurs, Product Owners, SRE, QA, équipes Infrastructure et Sécurité. Le poste combine une vision transverse du SI avec une forte proximité avec les équipes techniques.

Vos missions

  • Concevoir et faire évoluer l’architecture de nos applications, services et produits numériques en cohérence avec les besoins métiers et la trajectoire du SI.
  • Accompagner les équipes de développement dans leurs choix de conception, questionner les solutions proposées et garantir la cohérence entre les différents composants.
  • Faire évoluer l’existant en identifiant les possibilités de simplification, de modernisation et de restructuration, avec une approche pragmatique de la dette technique.
  • Intégrer les exigences non fonctionnelles dès la conception : performance, disponibilité, résilience, capacité à monter en charge, maintenabilité et sécurité.
  • Participer aux choix de technologies, frameworks, patterns et solutions techniques.
  • Faire progresser les pratiques d’architecture en contribuant aux choix technologiques et en définissant des principes, règles et méthodes de documentation partagés.
  • Travailler avec les équipes SRE, Infrastructure et Sécurité sur les problématiques Cloud, infrastructure, observabilité et sécurité.
  • Travailler sur les enjeux transverses du SI avec les équipes infrastructure, sécurité et qualité : cloud, conteneurisation, observabilité, sécurité et évolutions technologiques, notamment autour de l’IA.

Vos compétences

  • Vous avez une solide expérience en développement logiciel et avez progressivement élargi votre champ d'intervention vers des problématiques de conception et d’architecture.
  • Vous savez concevoir et faire évoluer des applications en ligne, des systèmes distribués et des APIs, dans un contexte cloud et conteneurisation.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Hosting Services
Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

Pleo's Intelligence function covers the full analytical picture - product behaviour, GTM performance, commercial data science, financial reporting, and operational intelligence. The Analytics Engineers who serve these teams own the data modelling layer that all of it runs on: dbt models, metric definitions, and semantic layer contributions that analysts, product teams, and AI tools depend on to get consistent, trustworthy answers.

You'll be embedded in the Product Intelligence team, building the tracking, experimentation, and data modelling foundations that make product data trustworthy and self-serve. You'll join a close-knit team actively migrating our analytics stack onto a new Analytics Warehouse and Omni, moving off legacy tools like Looker and Hippocampus. If you want to build the infrastructure that other people's product decisions run on rather than just report on what exists, this is the opportunity for you.

Who you'll work with and reporting to

You will report to an Analytics Manager leading Product Intelligence and Growth Intelligence. You'll partner closely with Product Managers, Product Analysts, and Engineering to get tracking, experimentation, and metric definitions right from the ground up. You'll also engage with the broader Analytics Engineering community across Pleo to drive shared standards, especially around the semantic layer that keeps metrics consistent across the organization.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and maintain dbt models in our new Analytics Warehouse, using a clean, layered architecture and migrating logic off legacy tools as you go.

  • Own tracking plan implementation and QA directly in Segment and Amplitude in close partnership with Product and Engineering.

  • Support experimentation by modelling assignment and outcome data into structured formats that analysts and PMs can query directly.

  • Define and document metrics in our semantic layer, ensuring a single authoritative definition so downstream BI tools and AI applications yield consistent answers.

  • Apply AI-augmented data modelling practices as a standard part of how you write, review, and migrate code.

  • Partner with Product Managers and Analysts to turn one-off questions into durable, reusable data models.

  • Maintain data quality in your domain through dbt tests, freshness SLAs, and proactive monitoring.

What you bring

  • Solid SQL and dbt experience, with a clear comfort owning models end to end.

  • Working knowledge of event-based tracking tools like Segment or Amplitude.

  • Experience with Git-based development workflows, including opening and reviewing pull requests.

  • Clear communication skills to explain data definitions and structures to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Genuine day-to-day use of AI tooling as part of your standard coding and workflow routine.

  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and untangling legacy logic to build modern foundations.

This role is NOT a good fit if

  • You only want to write dashboards without touching or owning the underlying data models.

  • You require rigid processes and heavy upfront structure before taking initiative.

  • You prefer to avoid data migration, cleanup work, and legacy system refactoring.

Your first 6 months

  • Ramp up: Master our dbt project structure, tracking plans, and migration roadmap while shipping small, reviewed code changes early on.

  • Take ownership: Own a dedicated slice of the migration, such as an event domain or our core experimentation data models.

  • Drive consistency: Establish semantic layer definitions for your domain so analysts and PMs can self-serve accurate metrics without custom workarounds.

Our tech stack context

  • Data warehouse: GCP / BigQuery (new Analytics Warehouse)

  • Transformation: dbt

  • Orchestration: Airflow

  • Tracking and Oroduct Analytics: Segment, Amplitude

  • BI and Analytics: Omni (migrating off legacy Looker and Hippocampus)

  • Languages: SQL

     

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days—enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office.

  • Comprehensive private healthcare depending on your location (coverage options include Vitality, Alan, or Médis).

  • 25 days of annual holiday plus public holidays, with the option to purchase 5 additional days through salary sacrifice.

  • Flexible working options supporting both hybrid and fully remote setups.

  • Free mental health and well-being support through MyndUp.

  • Generous paid parental leave policies to support growing families.

The interview process

  1. Intro Call: 30 minutes with our Talent Partner

  2. SQL Test: Completed via CoderPad

  3. Hiring Manager Interview: 45 minutes with our Data & Analytics Manager

  4. Team Interview & Live Case: Data modelling case via CodeSignal

  5. Final Interview: 30 minutes with our VP of Data & AI

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired an Analytics Engineer, we received a total of 173 applications but only 10 were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: it was very clear that many of the CVs we saw were very generic and AI generated. There is no issue with leveraging AI to help with CV writing, there was little indication of what real impact the candidates had in their previous experience. You might have heard of the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit Laszlo Bock ~2014), this is a great way to give a clear picture of what you have actually worked on. Some link or quick description of the companies you’ve worked with is also a great help.

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: there was misunderstanding about the type of experience we expect from an Analytics Engineer and we received many applications from candidates who had never been exposed to a product-led environment or had been exclusively focused on SQL/dbt work when we’re looking for both technical and stakeholders management and team collaboration experience. To be perfectly clear, this is NOT a Data Engineer role or a Data Analyst role! This is a heavily-driven dbt modelling role, experience in this area is critical. We’ve taken great care in writing this role description to reflect the reality of the job as best as possible, please ensure you read it carefully and highlight on your CV the experience relevant to what we are looking for.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with a Software Test Engineer who is passionate about quality, structured validation, and delivering robust software in complex engineering environments. 

As a Software Test Engineer, you will be responsible for defining and executing practical software tests to validate software components (including algorithms, cloud back-end, and user interfaces) that process sensor signals generated by fiber-optic sensing systems. You will work closely with data scientists, signal processing specialists, back-end developers, and software architects to ensure that products meet functional and non-functional requirements.

  • Identify, document, and track software defects, ensuring clear reproduction steps and proper follow-up.

  • Collaborate with product owners, developers and engineers to understand system requirements and ensure test coverage.

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of automated test frameworks and pipelines.

  • Test edge–cloud behaviour under interrupted connectivity, delayed or duplicated messages, device restarts, software updates, and synchronization failures.

  • Validate software performance, reliability, and stability under different operating conditions.

  • Support testing of software running on edge hardware, including hardware–software integration in laboratory and field environments.

  • Analyse test results and provide clear, actionable feedback to development teams.

  • Ensure traceability between requirements, test cases, and test results.

  • Integrate automated tests into GitLab CI/CD pipelines and help define appropriate quality gates.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes, tools, and quality standards.

  • Participate in release readiness reviews and ensure software meets quality benchmarks before deployment.

  • Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Experience with Docker, AWS, Gitlab , Linux and CI/CD pipelines.

Qualifications:

  • A degree in computer science, software engineering, embedded systems, or a related technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.

  • Experience with both exploratory/manual testing and automated testing.

jobs.title: Security Engineering Lead (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt.

Baue eine dauerhafte Product-Security-Engineering-Funktion für die Shopware-Produkte auf. Das Team verhindert wiederkehrende Schwachstellenklassen, schafft klare Zuständigkeiten und Reaktionszeiten für Sicherheitsaufgaben und unterstützt die Produktteams dabei, Risiken zu beheben, bevor daraus Sicherheitsvorfälle mit Auswirkungen auf Kundinnen und Kunden entstehen.

Product Security Engineering ist von der bestehenden SecOps- bzw. Information-Security-Funktion abgegrenzt. Die Funktion verantwortet die Ergebnisse im Bereich Product Security Engineering und das Betriebsmodell für diese Arbeit. Sie ersetzt weder die Governance durch InfoSec noch die Verantwortung der Engineering-Domänen, die Freigabe durch Quality oder Product Operations.


  • Entwickle und leite eine risikobasierte Product-Security-Roadmap für Commerce Core, Services und weitere Produktbereiche. Sorge für eine ausgewogene Gewichtung von Prävention, Erkennung, Incident-Bereitschaft und Behebung.

  • Verantworte das Modell für Eingang und Triage von Product-Security-Findings aus externen Meldungen, Bug-Bounty-Programmen, Penetrationstests, Dependency-Sicherheitshinweisen, internen Entdeckungen und Nacharbeiten zu Sicherheitsvorfällen. Vereinbare Schweregrade und Reaktionsziele mit den Domänenverantwortlichen und InfoSec, leite jeden Vorgang an den zuständigen Code Owner weiter und mache die laufenden Reaktionsfristen sichtbar.

  • Arbeite selbst aktiv mit: Erstelle Threat Models für sicherheitskritische Änderungen, prüfe risikoreiche Designs, untersuche Schwachstellen und implementiere besonders wirksame Sicherheitskontrollen in gemeinsam genutzten Produktkomponenten oder entwickle sie gemeinsam mit anderen.

  • Etabliere wiederholbare Vorgehensweisen für sicheres Design, Sicherheitsreviews, Tests von Missbrauchsszenarien, Dependency- und Code-Scanning, die Offenlegung von Schwachstellen und Incident-Bereitschaft.

  • Koordiniere produktübergreifende Sicherheitsarbeit über eine vereinbarte Dokumentation: GHSA für Angaben zur Offenlegung, ein privates GitHub-Issue oder Epic für Fixes und Backports sowie eine Confluence-Seite zum Sicherheitsvorfall oder Release für Rollen, Entscheidungen, QA-Status und Kommunikationsbereitschaft. Nutze Slack für die operative Abstimmung und verlinke getroffene Entscheidungen zurück in die Dokumentation.

  • Weise gemeinsam mit den Engineering Leads jedem bestätigten Problem eine technisch verantwortliche Person und einen Fälligkeitstermin zu. Eskaliere blockierte Behebungen und verbleibende Risiken über die etablierten Entscheidungswege von Product, InfoSec und der Führungsebene.

  • Verbessere die Sicherheitsabdeckung für unterstützte Versionen und zugehörige Produkte, darunter das Security Plugin, Commercial-Komponenten, Services sowie relevante App- und Extension-Schnittstellen.

  • Leite die technische Aufarbeitung nach Sicherheitsvorfällen und Releases. Überführe Ursachen in konkrete Präventionsmaßnahmen mit klarer Verantwortung, Tests, Tools oder Designänderungen und verfolge, ob diese Änderungen Wiederholungen reduzieren.

  • Fördere und entwickle die beiden Engineers weiter, stelle die Abdeckung von Commerce Core und Services sicher und mache die Arbeit des Teams in der Produktplanung sichtbar.

  • Arbeite mit InfoSec, Product Operations, Quality Operations, DevRel, Legal, Customer Support und der Product-Leitung an Entscheidungen zu Sicherheitsrichtlinien, Reaktionen, Releases und Kommunikation.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und nachweisbare Erfolge bei der Verbesserung der Sicherheit produktiv eingesetzter Produkte.

  • Praktische Kenntnisse in der Anwendungssicherheit, insbesondere zu Authentifizierung, Autorisierung, Zugriffskontrolle, Datentrennung, API-Sicherheit, Umgang mit Zugangsdaten, sicheren Integrationen und gängigen Schwachstellenklassen.

  • Erfahrung darin, Schwachstellenmeldungen zu untersuchen und daraus einen getesteten und priorisierten Behebungsplan für mehrere Teams oder unterstützte Versionen zu entwickeln.

  • Die Fähigkeit, direkt mit Code und Tests zu arbeiten und Sicherheitstools wie SAST, Dependency Scanning, Fuzzing oder Tests für Missbrauchsszenarien einzusetzen und zu verbessern.

  • Gutes Urteilsvermögen bei der Einschätzung von Ausnutzbarkeit, Auswirkungen auf Kundinnen und Kunden, Schweregrad, koordinierter Offenlegung und Incident Response.

  • Klare technische Dokumentation und souveräne, ruhige Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Teams bei dringenden und unklaren Aufgaben.

  • Erfahrung darin, Engineers zu fördern oder ein kleines technisches Team zu leiten. Formale Personalverantwortung ist hilfreich; technische Führung und Coaching sind wesentlich.

  • Kenntnisse von Open-Source-Produkten, Extension-Ökosystemen, Cloud-Services und Release-Modellen mit mehreren unterstützten Versionen sind von Vorteil.

Woran du deinen Erfolg erkennst:

  • Für Product-Security-Findings gibt es einen einheitlichen Eingang, eine namentlich benannte technische Verantwortung, einen Schweregrad, ein Reaktionsziel und einen sichtbaren Abschlussnachweis.

  • Teams können nachvollziehen, wer betroffen ist, was behoben wird und was getestet wurde, ohne den Status aus Slack rekonstruieren zu müssen.

  • Sicherheitskritische Änderungen erhalten rechtzeitig fachliche Unterstützung. Wiederkehrende Schwachstellenklassen führen zu konkreten Kontrollen und Regressionstests.

  • Sicherheits-Releases haben einen vereinbarten Umfang, eine zentrale Koordinationsdokumentation, klar benannte technische und QA-Verantwortliche sowie verifizierte Release-Artefakte.

  • Sicherheitsarbeit ist mit klaren Abwägungen und Eskalationswegen in der Planung vertreten, wenn sie mit bereits zugesagter Produktarbeit konkurriert.

  • Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler, Product Operations, Quality, InfoSec und DevRel wissen, wo Product Security Engineering die Führung übernimmt und wofür die jeweiligen Partner verantwortlich bleiben.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert.

  • Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit.

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge.

  • Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware.

  • Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy".

  • Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents.

... und vieles mehr!
Einen detaillierten Einblick bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite.

Deine Ansprechperson für diese Stelle ist Josephine Scheffler und steht dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung!

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben, Abs, Sabrina, and Rebe.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone hungry to learn and early in their career to join us as our Revenue Operations Associate!

You'll get an inside look at, and be a key part of, how a high-performing GTM function operates: this is a great opportunity for exceptionally smart, motivated individuals who want to immerse themselves in the world of tech startups and gain real exposure to what it takes to keep a high-growth business moving.

You'll sit at the intersection of our GTM, Customer and Finance teams, keeping our systems, data, and reporting sharp as we scale. This isn't a "keep the lights on" role – you'll inherit processes that are still being built, and you'll have real room to audit what's working, fix what isn't, and put your own stamp on how we operate.

You'll get broad exposure early: one week you might be untangling a HubSpot workflow, the next you're building a dashboard the CCO takes into a board meeting. It's a genuinely excellent grounding in how a B2B SaaS business scales – but it comes with real pace, longer hours than a typical first job, and a learning curve to match. If you want breadth of exposure and a steep climb early in your career, this is a great seat.

What Can You Expect?

  • Keep our GTM tech stack in good shape: Own day-to-day CRM administration – data hygiene, permissions, and workflow upkeep – and support the configuration and integration of the wider stack.

  • Stay ahead of what's new: Keep across releases and new features across our tools – joining release webinars, reading release notes, and flagging what's worth adopting.

  • Help evaluate and set up new tools: Get involved as we add to the stack, from evaluation through to implementation.

  • Improve our data quality: Spot where data is incomplete or inconsistent, fix what you can, and propose fixes for the rest.

  • Build reporting and dashboards: Turn raw data into dashboards and reports that track pipeline health, funnel conversion, and the other KPIs the GTM team relies on day to day.

  • Support incentive tracking: Help maintain and monitor commission and incentive tracking, making sure calculations are accurate.

  • Onboard new GTM joiners: Train new starters across the GTM and Customer teams on our tools and processes so they're productive quickly.

  • Own our recurring admin cadence: Take ownership of the regular tasks that keep the engine running and look to automate where ever possible.

About You

  • You have a top-class academic record: you'll have graduated with (or be on track for) a 1st class degree, or have attended one of the top universities in the country you studied in – we're looking for a strong, proven track record of academic performance as the clearest early signal of the analytical rigour this role needs.

  • You're curious about how technology fits together: you likely have a STEM background, and you enjoy working out how systems, data, and workflows connect to make a business run – even if you've never worked in RevOps before.

  • You want pace, eyes open: you're drawn to a fast-scaling business precisely because of the pace, and you understand that means longer hours and a steeper learning curve than a typical grad role. You see that as a trade worth making.

  • You're happy to get stuck in: you know not every task here is glamorous – some of it is spreadsheet clean-up, data hygiene, or repetitive admin – and you take real satisfaction in doing that work well, not just the exciting parts.

  • You want to understand how B2B SaaS businesses scale: you're looking to build a first-hand understanding of the GTM engine – pipeline, systems, data, and the commercial mechanics behind it – as a foundation for wherever your career goes next.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

Chez Withings, nous développons des appareils de santé connectée : nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd'hui utilisés par des millions d'utilisateurs. Notre objectif est de permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l'accompagnement d'un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de sa santé.

Au sein de l'équipe Machine Learning, nous développons des algorithmes pour extraire des informations physiologiques et médicales pour nos utilisateurs tels que le SPO2, la fréquence cardiaque, la présence de diverses pathologies comme la fibrillation atriale, l'apnée du sommeil…
Nous recherchons un ou une stagiaire motivé.e par des sujets de santé avec des compétences en traitement du signal, en machine learning et en deep learning pour nous aider à concevoir les algorithmes de demain.

Votre mission
L'objectif de ce stage est de concevoir, développer et valider des algorithmes capables d'extraire des informations physiologiques et médicales fiables à partir des signaux physiques collectés par nos dispositifs.
Pour mener à bien cette mission passionnante, la/le stagiaire aura l'opportunité de :

  • Explorer et analyser des ensembles de données physiologiques réelles issues de nos utilisateurs, à la recherche de marqueurs pertinents.
  • Concevoir et développer des algorithmes combinant des techniques de traitement du signal innovantes, des heuristiques informatiques fines, des approches Machine Learning et Deep Learning (supervisé ou non).
  • Travailler sur l'optimisation algorithmique en vue d'une implémentation embarquée, potentiellement en langage C, sur des systèmes aux ressources contraintes.
  • Participer à la définition des critères de succès et des métriques pour le mesurer, et évaluer la performance des algorithmes sur des jeux de données variés.

Ce stage offre une immersion complète dans le développement d'un produit de santé connecté de pointe, avec une application concrète et un impact direct sur la vie des utilisateurs. Vous rejoindrez une équipe multidisciplinaire et dynamique, où votre contribution sera essentielle pour transformer un prototype algorithmique en une fonctionnalité embarquée de nos dispositifs, conforme aux exigences de fiabilité et de performance de l'industrie médicale.
Le sujet précis sera discuté avec le stagiaire au plus tard quelques semaines avant le stage.

Requirements

  • Connaissances théoriques en traitement du signal et en machine learning
  • Compétences informatiques : programmation en Python, première expérience en framework deep learning (PyTorch ou TensorFlow) appréciée
  • Bonus : programmation en C
  • Intérêt pour le machine learning
  • Intérêt pour les applications en santé connectée
  • Lecture de l'anglais scientifique et technique
  • Capacité rédactionnelle, de rigueur et d'autonomie
  • Aptitude pour le travail en équipe et communication
  • Durée : 4 à 6 mois

Benefits

Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est :

  • Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show
  • Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution
  • Intégrer une entreprise internationale, membre de la FrenchTech 120, dont les équipes sont basées à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong-Kong et Shenzhen
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue de nos produits et services en les bêta-testant avant leur sortie, notamment lors de nos nombreuses sessions sportives entre collègues
  • Assister à des conférences de professionnels de santé afin de renforcer ses connaissances dans le domaine médical
